abbcba15.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a seasoned Technical Program Manager who thrives on orchestrating complex, high\-impact initiatives across multiple teams? Do you have a passion for translating strategic vision into flawlessly executed technical programs? Join our Seller Fees Tech organization and lead critical expansion efforts that will shape the 3P Stores business for millions of sellers globally.  

  

The Seller Fees Tech organization forms the foundation of Amazon's marketplace financial ecosystem, responsible for calculating, processing, and managing the complex fee structures that enable sellers to do business across Amazon's global marketplaces. Supporting over 2MM\+ active sellers, our systems handle billions of transactions annually, ensuring accurate and transparent fee calculations, incentive distributions, and financial adjustments for selling partners worldwide. Our work is fundamental to overall seller economics \- we enable sellers to build sustainable businesses through transparent fee structures, provide financial clarity that informs their pricing strategies and inventory decisions, and create incentive mechanisms that reward seller behaviors aligned with customer\-centric goals.  

  

As a TPM III on our Expansions team, you'll spearhead end\-to\-end execution of complex technical initiatives that require coordinating across multiple engineering teams, business units, and stakeholders. In addition, you'll lead the adoption of GenAI technologies to improve team efficiency and delivery capabilities, ensuring our technical solutions scale effectively across Amazon's growing global marketplace portfolio.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on both Amazon's marketplace growth strategy and the success of millions of entrepreneurs worldwide. Your ability to navigate technical complexity, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment will be crucial to our success.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key Responsibilities  

A. Program Leadership \& Execution  

Lead complex cross\-team programs
  

Develop comprehensive program plans with clear milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and resource requirements  

Proactively identify and mitigate risks that could impact program delivery or quality  

Drive execution through effective stakeholder management, clear communication, and disciplined issue resolution  

Define and track program success metrics, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements  

Facilitate decision\-making processes to resolve blockers and maintain program momentum  

B. Technical Leadership  

Partner with engineering leaders to align on technical approaches that balance scalability, performance, and time\-to\-market  

Lead the adoption of GenAI technologies to improve development efficiency and code quality across engineering teams  

Ensure architectural decisions consider cross\-marketplace compatibility and global scalability  

Facilitate technical design reviews and architecture discussions to drive consensus on implementation approaches  

Identify and address technical dependencies across systems and teams  

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define technical requirements that meet business needs  

C. Stakeholder Management  

Build strong relationships with engineering, product, operations, and business teams across the Seller Fees Tech organization  

Communicate program status, risks, and achievements effectively to senior leadership and key stakeholders  

Manage expectations and negotiate trade\-offs when facing competing priorities or resource constraints  

Create visibility into program progress through clear metrics, dashboards, and regular updates  

Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration to ensure alignment on program objectives and approaches

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with Gen\-AI technologies and tools

bdb63d4c.title: Senior Program Manager, RME Sort Center Mile Partner, Reliability and Maintenance Engineering, INOPs
bdb63d4c.description:
**Description**
 Scope:
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager, RME SC Mile Partner, INOps leads all strategic requirements across Amazon India's Sort Center network, encompassing 20 SCs across 12 cities and delivering across the length and breadth of the country. The role oversees nine critical verticals: Safety, Cost, New Technology Initiatives, Reliability Engineering, Base Building Management, Asset Performance Management (APM), Sustainability, Skill Development and Business Analytics across a diverse portfolio of building formats including small, medium, large and Extra Large SC. The role drives transformative initiatives including SC Championships, a technician and Blue Badge skill enhancement and assessment program. The role runs MBRs with Mile Ops Directors and all stakeholder function leaders, maintains strategic connects with HR Leaders and Ops on Voice of Associates to foster a better work environment, manages OP1/OP2 workflows, Blue Badge headcount planning, and Free Cash Flow (FCF) initiatives.
   

  

**Complexity**
 This role operates at the intersection of high growth, rapid transformation, and start\-up\-like ambiguity. India RME is accelerating from reactive to prescriptive maintenance while preparing for technology disruption through scalability of sorters and reliability centric maintenance programs at Indian sites in 2027 and beyond. These factors create a uniquely complex operating environment that demands strategic foresight, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to build while simultaneously delivering
   

  

**Impact**
 The role’s outcomes directly shape INRME SC’s cost, reliability, and talent trajectory:
   

  

* Embed a zero\-tolerance safety culture across all SCs.
* Drive OP budget cycle while understanding site\-level requirements
* Drive \>7% YoY cost efficiency via reduction in reactive repairs and idle asset management
* Improve asset reliability, targeting 99\.9% uptime and 97% sustainability compliance.
* Drive WBR for the SC business unit, manages Transfer of Asset (TOA) processes.
* Drive SC Championship for RME team.


 Collectively, these initiatives will position IN RME as Amazon’s most reliable, cost\-efficient, and safety\-first maintenance organization.
   

  

**Reach**
 The position's influence extends across Amazon's entire global network through contribution to one VP\-level SPS transformation pillars \- Talent Excellence, engaging with global counterparts to shape the future of maintenance operations worldwide. The role partners closely with WWRME team on technician LOTO compliance and janitorial excellence. Internally, the role coordinates with Ops Directors, HR Leaders, WHS, Procurement, Finance, Solution Engineering, Real Estate, Environment teams, and site teams across all regions. Additionally, the role drives safety training programs as corrective and preventive actions post incidents, shaping network\-wide safety standards and practices.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic: The role drives the OP budget cycle understanding site\-level requirements, while targeting \>10% cost savings by encouraging and horizontally deploying FCF initiatives.
   

  

 Operational: Deliver zero loss time injury and zero serious injury to technicians, drive safety compliance, and drives FCF initiatives.
   

  

 Financial: Govern RME SC OPEX and enable \>10% YoY savings through analytics, spare control, and preventive strategies.
   

  

 People: Develop technicians and close technical skill gaps through learning programs, capability building and reduced non\-technical workload.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager, RME SC Mile Partner begins the day by reviewing network safety, reliability, and cost performance, addressing critical escalations across the Sort Center network.
   

  

 The role partners with Operations, WHS, HR, Finance, Procurement, and Engineering leaders to drive strategic initiatives, business reviews, and annual operating plans.
   

  

 Throughout the day, the Program Manager analyzes data to identify reliability and cost improvement opportunities, standardizes best practices, and oversees programs spanning safety, sustainability, technician capability, and new technology.
   

  

 Success requires balancing strategic planning with operational execution while influencing stakeholders to deliver a safer, more reliable, and cost\-efficient network.
   

  

**About The Team**
 INRME mission is to build India’s safest, most efficient, and lowest\-cost reliability and maintenance organization.
   

  

 The team manages maintenance, asset reliability, engineering programs, automation, utilities, sustainability, and infrastructure projects across the network, partnering closely with Operations to maximize equipment uptime, enhance customer experience, and support business growth.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end\-to\-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **EY Job Description**
**SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager**
**Job Title:**
 SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide executive\-level delivery leadership for global SAP transformation programs from planning through deployment and steady\-state support.
* Own delivery governance for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, RISE, testing, release management, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across business, functional, technical, application support, infrastructure, and third\-party teams to protect delivery quality and business continuity.


**Key responsibilities include:**
**Project \& Program Management**
* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**
* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.


**Business Process \& Solution Design**
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**
* Be a thought leader on data migration strategy and execution for master and transactional data.
* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**
* Engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.
* Mentor consultants and develop effective project teams through clear direction, knowledge sharing, and delivery discipline.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires sound judgment across delivery scope, schedule, budget, risk, testing, cutover, data migration, integration, and stakeholder decisions. The candidate will evaluate cross\-functional trade\-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and resolve issues in a global, matrixed SAP environment while protecting release quality, service stability, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Strong command of SAP delivery methods, governance routines, risk controls, testing models, release practices, and global rollout execution.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full\-cycle SAP implementations, migrations, production cutovers, and global rollouts.
* Experience leading SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE delivery across testing, release governance, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.

* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.

* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.

 Master's Degree

Data Architect  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**HPE Operations** is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.***Management Level Definition:***


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Architect with over a decade of expertise in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise\-scale data architectures. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in database design, data modeling, and data engineering, ensuring that data systems are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands\-on design capabilities, and the ability to collaborate across business and IT teams to enable data\-driven decision\-making.

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Architecture \& Strategy**
	+ Define and maintain the organization’s enterprise data architecture blueprint.
	+ Develop strategies for data integration, storage, retrieval, and governance.
	+ Ensure data architecture aligns with business goals and analytics needs.
* **Database Design \& Optimization**
	+ Design and optimize relational and non\-relational database schemas for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
	+ Implement indexing, partitioning, and query optimization techniques.
	+ Ensure database designs adhere to normalization, security, and compliance requirements.
* **Data Engineering \& Integration**
	+ Oversee data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data transformation workflows.
	+ Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data from multiple sources.
	+ Support real\-time and batch processing solutions.
* **Data Governance, Security \& Compliance**
	+ Implement data governance frameworks to ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy.
	+ Define and enforce data security policies, access controls, and encryption standards.
	+ Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, and industry standards.
* **Collaboration \& Leadership**
	+ Partner with analytics, BI, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver data solutions.
	+ Mentor data engineers, modelers, and database administrators.
	+ Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction on data\-related projects.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, or related field.
* **Experience:** 10\+ years in data architecture, database design, and data engineering.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Must be strong in PostgreSQL, ClickHouse \& Cassandra
* Proficiency in RDBMS (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis).
* Strong knowledge of data modeling tools (ERwin, PowerDesigner, etc.).
* Expertise in big data platforms (Hadoop, Spark) and cloud data services (AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, Google BigQuery).
* Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, AWS Glue) and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis).
* **Certifications (preferred):** AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty, Google Professional Data Engineer, Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer.
* **Soft Skills:** Analytical thinking, leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

**Accessibility**

  

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

  

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**

**Qualifications**

d1a2a650.description:
**Senior Consultant \| Cloud Migration \| Bengaluru \| Engineering \| Platform Development \& Integration**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 112506
* **Location**: Bengaluru
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

  



Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact\-driven decision\-making and generate an insight\-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.  



**Your work profile**



We are migrating a portfolio of on\-premise Java Spring Boot applications — many of which depend on on\-prem Apache Kafka clusters for event streaming, and inter\-service messaging — to Amazon Web Services. We need an experienced engineer who has done this end\-to\-end before: assessing applications, untangling on\-prem dependencies, re\-platforming to AWS\-managed services where it makes sense (and lifting\-and\-shifting where it doesn't), cutting over with zero data loss, and leaving behind a clean, observable, cost\-efficient footprint. You will own technical migration of multiple Spring Boot services from discovery through stabilization, partnering with the application teams who built them and the platform team that runs AWS.

  


**Key skills required:**

  

* 8\+ years of experience developing production\-grade backend applications using Java
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data, and Spring Security
* 5\+ years of production experience with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic design, partitioning, consumer groups, schema evolution, and Kafka operations
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience delivering production workloads on AWS
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end migration of multiple on\-premise applications and Kafka workloads to AWS
* Strong experience with Java 17 / 21 and modern Java features, including records, pattern matching, virtual threads, and JVM performance tuning
* Strong experience with Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6, including Jakarta EE migration and modernization of deprecated APIs
* Hands\-on experience with Spring for Apache Kafka and/or Spring Cloud Stream, including Kafka listeners, error handling, retries, transactions, and transactional producers
* Strong experience with Amazon MSK / MSK Serverless or Confluent Cloud on AWS, including Kafka migration, replication, security, and consumer\-group cutover
* Experience with Kafka migration tools and strategies such as MirrorMaker 2, MSK Replicator, or Confluent Replicator
* Strong knowledge of AWS services including EKS, ECS / Fargate, RDS / Aurora, S3, IAM, MSK, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, KMS, Route 53, ALB / NLB, VPC, API Gateway, and related services
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and containerization, including multi\-stage builds and production\-ready container images
* Experience deploying containerized Java applications on Amazon EKS, ECS Fargate, App Runner, or Lambda based on workload requirements
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using AWS CDK and/or Terraform
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and/or GitHub Actions
* Experience with relational and NoSQL data migration using AWS DMS, RDS / Aurora, DocumentDB, or MongoDB Atlas
* Strong understanding of AWS security, IAM, encryption, secrets management, TLS, security groups, VPC Endpoints, PrivateLink, WAF, and GuardDuty
* Experience implementing observability using Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, AWS X\-Ray, Datadog, or Dynatrace
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot application, JVM, Kafka, network, and cloud performance issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across application, infrastructure, security, and platform teams
  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Education \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field


* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty
* CKA, CKAD, or CKS certification
* Experience with hybrid cloud networking, including AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN, PrivateLink, and on\-premise\-to\-AWS routing
* Experience with Confluent Schema Registry, Avro, and Protobuf, including schema compatibility checks and registry promotion
* Experience implementing exactly\-once semantics, idempotent producers, transactional producers, and Kafka Streams
* Experience with Kafka performance tuning, including acks, linger.ms, batch.size, max.poll.records, enable.idempotence, and consumer rebalancing
* Experience with JVM diagnostics and performance engineering using thread dumps, heap analysis, JFR, async\-profiler, G1, and ZGC
* Experience with GraalVM, Spring AOT, and native image optimization
* Experience with AWS Graviton\-based workloads and cloud cost optimization
* Experience implementing database CDC, dual\-write strategies, and the outbox pattern during phased application and Kafka migrations
* Experience working in enterprise\-scale migration, consulting, technology services, or cloud transformation environments

  


**Key Skills \& Competencies**


* Java 17 / 21 and Spring Boot 3
* Spring Framework 6, Spring Data, and Spring Security
* Apache Kafka 3\.x and Spring for Apache Kafka
* Amazon MSK / MSK Serverless / MSK Connect
* Kafka migration, replication, partitioning, consumer groups, and zero\-data\-loss cutover
* AWS EKS, ECS Fargate, Lambda, and containerized workloads
* AWS IAM, VPC, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and security services
* RDS / Aurora, AWS DMS, DocumentDB, S3, and data migration
* AWS CDK / Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
* Docker, Maven / Gradle, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions
* Confluent Schema Registry, Avro, Protobuf, and schema evolution
* JVM performance tuning, JFR, heap analysis, thread dumps, and async\-profiler
* Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing
* Hybrid cloud networking and on\-premise\-to\-AWS connectivity
* Application modernization and migration strategy
* Security, compliance, encryption, IAM, and least\-privilege architecture
* Cloud cost optimization and right\-sizing
* Technical documentation, ADRs, migration runbooks, SLOs, and operational playbooks
* Stakeholder management, technical communication, and cross\-functional collaboration

This role drives end‑to‑end execution across multiple engineering, product, and business teams, ensuring alignment to strategic priorities, disciplined delivery, and measurable impact.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth, seasoned program leadership, and the ability to influence at all levels. They translate ambiguous business objectives into clear execution plans, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and ensure predictable, high‑quality delivery across large‑scale initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead and successfully deliver multiple concurrent, complex, and cross functional technical programs from concept through launch, ensuring alignment to business and security objectives
* Act as a strategic partner to Engineering, Product, Security, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes
* Own end to end program planning and execution, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments
* Define and track clear milestones, success metrics, and program health indicators to ensure predictable delivery
* Drive execution rigor by managing dependencies, facilitating deep technical discussions, aligning on architecture decisions, and navigating engineering trade offs
* Proactively identify execution risks, surface trade offs, and drive timely risk mitigation and decision making
* Provide clear, concise, executive level status updates, metrics, and data driven recommendations to leadership
* Establish and continuously improve program governance, delivery processes, and operational excellence best practices
* Serve as a strong voice for the team—leading demos, acceptance discussions, and representing the program with confidence across forums as needed
* Mentor and guide junior TPMs and less experienced team members, fostering growth, accountability, and high standards of execution


**All About You:**
* Proven ability to operate in ambiguous, fast‑paced environments
* Exceptional stakeholder communication and influencing skills
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and delivery excellence
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and agile delivery in complex, multi‑team environments.
* Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems, plan and execute work through Agile delivery models (Scrum, Kanban), and consistently deliver high impact technical programs.
* Comfortable diving deep into technical details to inform trade offs, manage risk, and build credibility with engineering teams.
* Demonstrates data driven decision making and leads continuous improvement across teams and programs.
* Effectively partners with business leaders, architects, engineers, and designers to shape delivery strategy and execution plans.
* Builds strong relationships and influences without authority, earning trust and respect across dependent teams.
* Exhibits strong technical writing, documentation, and knowledge transfer skills, enabling teams beyond immediate scope to operate independently.

8f6e84e4.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
8f6e84e4.description:
**Description**
 Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.
   

  

 Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per\-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination, and partners with WW Operations, Finance, Returns, Concessions, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true cost drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high\-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.
   

  

 Are you passionate about building AI\-powered cost intelligence solutions at scale? Amazon's RBS CtS organization is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead our charter for identification of emerging cost trends, which serves as the first step in the journey of Defect Identification and contributes to the organization’s defect elimination work. This role serves as the primary business POC, engaging with RBS, Retail category, FBA and Finance teams in managing two projects (i) Project Strata, a layered analytical product built on a "peel the layers" philosophy that gives RBS and Stores leadership a unified, one\-stop view of how Cost to Serve is trending — decomposing headline P\&L costs into granular operational drivers and identifying cost opportunities through benchmarking between different time periods, MPs, channels and business lines. (ii) Defining and setting up P0 output and input metrics for RBS's UDE program. **Description**

Your program meets business goals and/or shows measurable improvements in your customer’s experience, business or employee efficiency or execution, compliance adherence, financial or other metrics, etc.

You influence team priorities and business strategy through data\-supported contributions. You are able to make a case for project priorities, resource allocation, and/or appropriate program adoption, to achieve a desired business outcome, resolve a technical deficiency, or unblock delivery.
* You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
* Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
* You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.
* You actively participate in the hiring process as well as mentor others \- improving their skills and ability to get things done.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. 805d6190.description:
**Role Description**
**Role Summary**
* Customer\-facing technical owner for opportunities and implementations.
* Convert media, data and AI problems into secure, scalable and production\-ready solutions.
* Own architecture from discovery and pilot through engineering, deployment and handover.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead discovery with customer business, product, data, AI, security and engineering teams.
* Define use cases, target workflows, architecture, integrations, data flows, non\-functional requirements and roadmaps.
* Preserve a reusable, model\-agnostic core while allowing controlled customer configuration.
* Assess data readiness, model fit, integration effort, cost, assumptions and delivery risks.
* Support proposals and SOWs, and remain accountable through architecture reviews and production sign\-off.


**AI, Platform \& Cloud Architecture**
* Apply deep knowledge of video/multimodal AI, computer vision, speech AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, reranking, RAG, recommendations and agentic workflows.
* Turn model outputs into reliable decisions using metadata, ontology, business rules, confidence thresholds, ranking, temporal logic, human review and feedback.
* Define model evaluation across accuracy, precision, recall, relevance, temporal grounding, latency, throughput, explainability and cost.
* Design AI pipelines for ingestion, preprocessing, retrieval, inference, validation, feedback and continuous evaluation.
* Architect APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, workflow engines, vector databases, model serving and enterprise integrations.
* Integrate with MAM/DAM, CMS, media supply chain, data platforms, OTT/player, AdTech, localization and observability systems.
* Define Hyperscaler deployment, Kubernetes/container patterns, security, resilience, observability, DR and cost controls.
* Shape MLOps for model/prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, rollback, lineage and cost tracking.


**Hands\-On \& Collaboration**
* Create or review prototypes, APIs, notebooks, model evaluations, architecture diagrams and deployment designs.
* Inspect payloads, logs, traces, model outputs and performance metrics to resolve issues with engineering teams.
* Guide AI/ML, Data, Backend, Frontend, DevOps and QA teams on architecture and quality standards.
* Partner closely with the Product Lead and Engineering Head on reusable capabilities and implementation sequencing.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* 9–10 years of technology experience, including Building and shipping AI Saas products / solutions , solution architecture, enterprise integration or cloud\-native engineering ownership.
* At least 3–4 years of substantive AI/ML, data, automation or intelligent\-platform architecture experience.
* Proven customer\-facing experience leading discovery workshops, technical reviews and complex stakeholder discussions.
* Ownership of at least one solution from discovery or presales through pilot, engineering, deployment and handover.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, data pipelines, CI/CD, observability and security.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to validate integrations and prototypes.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and container/Kubernetes deployments.
* Strong communication, estimation, problem structuring, risk management and architecture\-documentation skills.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.


**Preferred Media Experience**
* Media \& Entertainment, OTT/streaming, broadcast, studios, MAM/DAM, AdTech, localization, live sports, QoE or video\-processing workflows.

* Expertise in complex systems integration, with sound knowledge of implementation and integration challenges and their architectural implications.
* Knowledge of corporate banking is an additional advantage


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.

 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.

* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.

feda363d.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
feda363d.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

f6cec7d0.title: Solutions Architect - India
f6cec7d0.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

25e09566.description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
 



  





 As an IFS Cloud EAM and ERP \- Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver innovative solutions within our Business Application Consulting practice. You will leverage your skills in Maximo Consulting to address complex challenges and drive impactful results. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and develop a deeper understanding of the business context. You will guide and mentor others, navigating complex situations to deliver quality work and grow your personal brand.
 



  





 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on Field Service \& Operations Modernisation. You will utilize your knowledge of Functional \& Industry Technologies to support client engagements and contribute to the firm's overall business strategies. This position offers the opportunity to enhance your technical skills and develop your ability to anticipate client needs, all while working in a supportive and collaborative environment.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 •Design, develop, and implement custom solutions in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP. Customize IFS modules to meet specific business needs by writing and modifying PL/SQL code, utilizing APIs, and creating custom fields, menus, and reports.
 



 •Develop and implement integration solutions using IFS Connect/REST (OData/Projections) and coordinate cutover to Ensure seamless data flow and integrity across the organization.
 



 •Own data migration using templates, cleansing rules, validation, migration jobs and coordinate cutover.
 



 •Configure IFS Cloud Aurana (Lobbies, Workflows, pages, custom fields/actions, projections), permissions/security, and application parameters.
 



 •Develop reports/analytics using Quick Reports/SQL, IFS Report Designer, IFS Report Studio.
 



 •Collaborate with functional teams, business analysts, and project managers to gather requirements and create technical specifications. Document technical changes, configurations, and custom code to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability.
 



 •Provide technical support to resolve complex issues within the IFS system, identifying root causes and implementing timely fixes. Troubleshoot performance issues and recommend optimization techniques to enhance system efficiency.
 



 •Support the upgrade process for IFS Cloud, including testing, data migration, and user acceptance testing. Work closely with the IFS support team and internal IT to manage patches, upgrades, and enhancements.
 



 •Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on root\-cause analysis and solution\-based development.
 



 •Effective communication skills to convey technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 •Ability to manage development tasks within project timelines and adapt to changing priorities.
 



 • High level of accuracy and focus on quality in development work and documentation.
 



  





 What You Must Have
 



  





 \- At least a Bachelor's degree
 



 \- At least 5\+ years of experience
 



 \- Oral and written proficiency in English required
 



 •Minimum 5\+ years of experience working with IFS Cloud and 2\+ years of experience in Integration Experience.
 



 •5\+ years of experience as a technical developer in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP environments.
 



 •Experience in at least 2 end to end implementation of any IFS Cloud Projects
 



 •Implementation and configuration knowledge across IFS Cloud ERP, EAM,
 



 •Demonstrated configuration expertise in core EAM processes (PM programs, work orders, resources, failure codes, materials).
 



 •Working knowledge of Projections/REST APIs, IFS Connect, security/permission sets, and data migration tools.
 



 •Strong PLSQL (Oracle) for troubleshooting and Reports.
 



 •Understanding of discrete and/or process workflows and how they integrate with IFS Cloud module.
 



 •Exposure to integration between IFS Cloud and other systems.
 



 •IFS Functional Certified Practitioner in Financials/ Human Capital management / Supply Chain / Manufacturing / Project ( Preferred )
 



 •IFS Certified Practitioner Technical Consultant ( Required )
 



 •IFS Certified Practitioner Integration Developer
 



 IFS Practitioner Consultant – Asset management – IFS Cloud
 



  





 What Sets You Apart
 



  





 \- Preference for a Master's degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems, Materials Science and Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Production Engineering
 



 \- Embracing emerging technologies in energy and utilities sectors
 



 \- Navigating complex enterprise integration projects
 



 \- Excelling in analytical thinking and problem\-solving
 



 \- Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and learning agility

b572c6bc.description:
**About Unosecur**
 Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.
   

  

 You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space
* Strong conceptual understanding of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — how companies structure their cloud (organizations, projects, subscriptions) and the common security challenges they face
* Solid foundation in security concepts such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity \& Access Governance (IAG), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and compliance standards
* Exceptional ability to present technical solutions to non\-technical audiences — can run a demo and handle objections with confidence
* Proven discovery skills: asking the right questions to uncover customer pain points and mapping them to technical solutions
* Startup agility: prior experience in early or growth\-stage startups, with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity


**Nice to Have**
* Experience selling or working with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID) and cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
* Able to read and explain scripts as well as REST APIs
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or similar

 Atlassians have flexibility in where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the enterprise sales team and regional channel partners to gain a deep understanding of our customers' needs. You will strategize on navigating various scenarios, deliver compelling demonstrations, and ultimately drive business closure. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring that our solutions effectively meet the demands of our clients, contributing to their success and the growth of Atlassian.

 With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca\-Cola advance humanity through the power of incredible software that unleashes the potential of every team.

We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. * Sales Collaboration: Build strong partnerships with sales counterparts to improve engagement and optimize the sales cycle.
* Customer Advocacy: Gather customer feedback and competitive insights, sharing them with product teams to influence improvements.

 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. 8891ad89.title: Solutions Engineer
8891ad89.description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to prospective customers in the US market. You will own the technical evaluation journey end\-to\-end, from the first discovery call to closing the deal, by demonstrating how our platform solves real\-world data integration challenges. This role involves working closely with global customers (primarily North America ), designing scalable architectures, running tailored product demos, and building proofs\-of\-concept that showcase value.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end\-to\-end.
* Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e. g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4 Snowflake, dbt).
* Run live product demos tailored to the customer's stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
* Own the technical evaluation from the first conversation to the closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.
* Build proofs\-of\-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
* Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
* Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.
* Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience as a Data engineer, Analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or Data warehouse engineer.
* Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.
* Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
* Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* This is non\-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo's technical capability to a global customer base. That means:
* Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience.
* You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls.
* You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.
* You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation.
* You have presented or demoed something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.
* Genuine interest in customer\-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.



  





**Good to have:** 



* Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline and integration tools.
* Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions.
* Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders or analytics teams or working with international teams across time zones.

* Core responsibilities to include Designing, Developing, Unit testing and Validation of New modification and provide support to any production issues related to Modification

* Application Architecture: MOCA, PageBuilder and Integrator
* Cloud Architecture: MS Azure

* Strong domain knowledge in Blue Yonder/RedPrairie WMS solution to understand how the Blue Yonder solutions can be configured and delivered to better facilitate customer business processes

*

* Provides level 3 user support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity
* Serves as a technical liaison and attends and contributes to key meetings between Project Manager, key customer contacts, and customer users, up to and including key executive project sponsors.

* Expertise in technical configuration of WMS product, Solution Integration, Quality Assurance, System Testing, PLSQL, SQL Server, and Performance Tuning.

* Ability to resolve complex problems with minimal guidance.

* Ability to develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with customers, partners and consultants
* Strong proactive communicator and presenter, able to influence and collaborate at all levels of an organization to maximize problem resolution while effectively presenting information and responding to highly specialized technical questions
* Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
* Ability to effectively and proactively work independently
* Teamwork mentality
* Contributes to the growth of the technical consulting practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral.
* Ensures compliance with the following internal and external company policies and procedures: Company project methodology On\-time submission of Time, Travel and Expenses report Company procedures related to travel and expenses
* Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs
* Knowledge in performance tuning techniques is added advantage.
* Knowledge on Azure fundamentals

* Understanding and experience with the technical requirements for the product line assigned.
* Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various technical platforms and infrastructures.
* Understands Blue Yonder product suite so as to convey relationships and touch\-points to the customer.

* Travel readiness based on business needs.

a9a49876.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

786d42b3.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .
