**Level** 
 : Lead Business Transformation Architect
   

  

 As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 We are looking for a seasoned Five9 CCaaS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise\-grade cloud contact center solutions built on the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform. This is a senior technical role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, AI\-driven automation, and client advisory — equal parts strategist and builder.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on Five9 expertise, a strong grasp of modern CCaaS architecture patterns, and the communication fluency to translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for clients and stakeholders.
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead end\-to\-end CCaaS solution design — from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and rollout. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performing Five9 architectures that align with client goals and industry best practices.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as the primary technical authority across multiple concurrent client engagements. Conduct solution and code reviews, establish architecture governance standards, and maintain quality assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Five9 Platform Configuration \& Deployment: Design and configure the full breadth of Five9 capabilities including VCC Core, ACD/IVR/IVA (Intelligent Virtual Agent) with complex call flows, outbound campaigns and predictive dialing logic, Workforce Automation (WFA), Quality Management (QM/WEM), digital channels, and AI\-driven features such as Five9 Genius AI.
* Integration \& Connectivity Architecture: Architect and implement enterprise\-grade integrations with CRM and ITSM platforms — including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and Zendesk — using Five9's pre\-built adapters and the Agent Desktop Toolkit Plus (ADT\+). 7 8 Design and implement REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and advanced scripting. Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.
* AI \& Automation Strategy: Drive the adoption of Five9's Genius AI capabilities — including Intelligent Voice Assistants, AI\-powered Agent Assist, the AI Summary Node, Knowledge Node (RAG\-based), and the AI Trust \& Governance framework. Provide architectural guidance on deploying responsible, hallucination\-aware AI within the contact center environment. 9 10 Stay ahead of Five9's evolving Agentic CX roadmap and help clients position for next\-generation capabilities.
* Performance Optimization \& Reporting: Configure dashboards, real\-time reporting, and supervisor tools to monitor and continuously optimize contact center operations. Guide clients on best practices for scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application, platform, network, cloud, and telecom layers. Drive rapid resolution with minimal disruption to customer\-facing operations.
* Collaboration, Scoping \& Delivery: Partner with project managers for accurate effort estimation, scoping, risk management, and on\-time delivery. Lead and mentor engineers, consultants, and junior delivery team members to elevate technical capability and solution quality across the team.
* Client Engagement \& Presentations: Deliver compelling client\-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and value propositions. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.


**The team:**
 Our Sales \& Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user\-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data\-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on architecture experience with the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform, including VCC, IVR/IVA, WFA, QM/WEM, and digital channels
* Advanced understanding of CCaaS architecture patterns, enterprise scalability design, and cloud contact center infrastructure
* Solid understanding of core contact center operations: ACD, IVR, CTI, and CRM integration workflows
* Experience migrating legacy on\-premise contact centers to Five9 cloud environments
* Proficiency in enterprise integration design using REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and scripting languages (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
* Strong command of authentication protocols: SSO, SAML, OAuth
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CX — chatbots, virtual agents, predictive analytics, agent assist, and GenAI\-driven capabilities
* Awareness of compliance and security frameworks relevant to CCaaS: PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR
* Bonus: Server\-side development experience in Node.js, Java, PHP, or .NET
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to present confidently to executive and technical audiences
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop delivery teams
* Strong client advisory mindset — able to frame technical decisions in terms of business outcomes


**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
* Five9 Certifications: Five9 Certified Administrator, Five9 Certified Implementor, or Global Partner Certified Implementation Partner credentials are highly desirable
* AI/GenAI Certifications: A plus, given the growing centrality of Genius AI and agentic workflows in Five9 deployments


**Education:**

5f64cdbc.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

d3ebe06d.description:
**About the Company** 




 Viscadia is a premier global forecasting firm that empowers the life sciences industry with clarity and confidence. Our team of specialists builds custom forecasting solutions, conducts targeted market research, and provides comprehensive cycle support to optimize decision\-making. Since our founding in 2010, we've assembled industry\-leading experts with decades of experience, establishing Viscadia as a trusted partner to many of the largest global life sciences companies. Our excellence has been recognized by both our industry through prestigious awards including Best in Business, Power Partners, Vault and Great Place to Work certification. Our success is built on core values of Resilience (working effectively as a team), Innovation (continuously improving customer experience), Shared Success (recognizing collective achievement), and Excellence (embedding servant leadership throughout our organization).
 



  





 We are seeking an Associate Consultant to join our India team based in Gurgaon. This role at Viscadia offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of software development, healthcare analytics, and consulting. You will contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of modern web applications and digital platforms used to support pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics. Through hands\-on project work and collaboration with cross\-functional teams, you will deepen your technical expertise, develop an understanding of pharmaceutical business needs, and build a strong foundation for a consulting career.
 



  





**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Technical Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS.
* Build and maintain cloud\-native solutions using services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ECS/EKS, Lambda, CloudFront, Route53, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
* Implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment, testing, and infrastructure provisioning.
* Design and manage containerized workloads using Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (EKS).
* Configure and maintain cloud networking components, including VPCs, subnets, load balancers, security groups, VPNs, and connectivity solutions.
* Implement cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance controls.
* Monitor cloud environments using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and centralized logging solutions to ensure system reliability and performance.
* Automate operational tasks, environment provisioning, system maintenance, and incident response processes using Python and cloud\-native automation tools.
* Optimize infrastructure utilization and cloud spending through performance tuning, resource right\-sizing, and cost\-management initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across infrastructure, networking, deployment pipelines, and cloud services.
* Collaborate with development teams to establish cloud architecture standards, deployment strategies, and operational best practices.
* Support disaster recovery, backup, high availability, and business continuity initiatives across cloud environments.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and platform modernization initiatives.



  





**Business Responsibilities** 



* Support the development and enhancement of forecasting and analytics platforms tailored to the needs of pharmaceutical clients across various therapeutic areas
* Build in depth understanding of pharma forecasting concepts, disease areas, treatment landscapes, and market dynamics to contextualize forecasting models and inform platform features
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to ensure forecast deliverables align with client objectives, timelines, and decision\-making needs
* Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement by mentoring junior team members and helping codify best practices in forecasting and business analytics
* Grow into a client\-facing role, combining an understanding of commercial strategy with forecasting expertise to lead engagements and drive value for clients



**Skills \& Technical Proficiencies** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Strong programming skills in Python, with experience building backend applications, automation scripts, APIs, and cloud\-native solutions.
* Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, optimization, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS Cloud Services, including services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/EKS, and related cloud\-native technologies.
* Working knowledge of other cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is preferred.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs, microservices, and serverless applications.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, source control systems (Git), and DevOps practices for automated deployments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes is a plus.
* Understanding of cloud security, networking concepts, monitoring, logging, and performance optimization.
* Exposure to modern web technologies and full\-stack application development is desirable.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in distributed cloud environments.



**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities, with a structured and solution\-oriented mindset
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross\-functional teams
* Adaptable and proactive, with a willingness to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-growing environment
* Genuine passion for consulting, with a focus on delivering tangible business value for clients



**Domain Expertise (Good To Have)** 



* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, including treatment journeys, market dynamics, and key therapeutic areas
* Experience working with and interpreting industry\-standard datasets such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, or similar secondary data sources
* Familiarity with product lifecycle management, market access considerations, and sales performance tracking metrics used across the pharmaceutical value chain



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) from a premier engineering institute, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines
* 2\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, or software development, with a strong focus on AWS\-based solutions.



  





**Benefits** 



* Competitive Compensation \& Performance Incentives: We offer a highly competitive compensation package, complemented by performance\-based incentives that reward excellence, innovation, and leadership. To support your transition, we also provide relocation assistance and reimbursement for moving closer to our office location. In addition, Gratuity, as applicable, is paid in accordance with The Payment of Gratuity Act, over \& above the CTC.
* Comprehensive Health \& Wellness Benefits: Our benefits are thoughtfully designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well\-being. From health insurance and wellness programs to flexible work arrangements, we prioritize your holistic success and balance.
* Generous Leave policy: Our leave framework includes, but is not limited to, Sick leave, casual leave, earned leave, bereavement leave, maternity \& paternity leave – ensuring you have the flexibility and support you need at different stages of life.
* Global Exposure \& Collaborative Culture: Work in a high\-impact, intellectually stimulating environment that values collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning. You will have opportunities to engage with global clients, cross\-functional teams, and industry thought leaders across geographies.
* Career Development \& Growth Pathways: At Viscadia, your growth is our priority. We offer structured career development programs, leadership training, and opportunities to expand your expertise through global projects, conferences, and innovation initiatives.
* Viscadia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Collaboration and Multi\-Customer Management • Engage with multiple customers simultaneously, providing high\-impact architectural consultations and fostering strong relationships. • Work closely with internal teams and global partners to ensure seamless collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects. • Maintain a hands\-on technical credibility, staying current with industry trends and mentoring others in the organization.

**Job Description: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant** 




**Experience Required:** 
 6–8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (1st preference). Other locations are also fine.
 



**Work Mode** 
 : Hybrid/India
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with subledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a
 **production support environment**
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure



  





**Preferred/Good to Have** 



* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset with a sense of urgency during close periods
* Good client communication and ticket documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tickets/priorities simultaneously
* Team player with willingness to support on\-call/rotational schedules

9af95d58.title: Delivery Manager
9af95d58.description:
**About dunnhumby**
 dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Meijer, Procter \& Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.
   

  

**Technology \& Engineering**
 dunnhumby’s Technology and Engineering team builds the platforms, pipelines and systems that make customer data science possible at scale. From the data infrastructure that ingests billions of transactions to the APIs and cloud architecture that power our products, we engineer reliable, high\-performance software trusted by the world’s leading retailers and brands.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to lead delivery across a portfolio of technology teams and strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for driving predictable delivery, operational excellence, and governance across multiple teams while partnering with senior leaders to ensure successful business outcomes. You'll play a key role in developing delivery capability and continuously improving how we plan, deliver, and scale technology solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 You'll help shape and lead delivery across multiple teams, ensuring that technology initiatives are delivered effectively while balancing priorities, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
   

  

* Own delivery performance across a portfolio of teams and strategic initiatives, driving alignment to quarterly and annual commitments.
* Establish and evolve delivery governance, planning standards, forecasting processes, and delivery best practices.
* Proactively manage portfolio risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring effective mitigation and informed decision\-making.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to provide clear delivery insights, lead governance reviews, and support strategic prioritisation.
* Coach and develop Delivery Leads and Scrum Masters while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.


**What We're Looking For**
 You'll bring strong delivery leadership experience, a collaborative approach, and the ability to influence outcomes across complex technology environments.
   

  

* Experience leading delivery across multiple agile teams, programmes, or value streams within Product and Engineering\-led organisations.
* People leadership capability, including coaching and developing Delivery Leads, Scrum Masters, or similar delivery professionals.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and modern delivery practices, with a focus on continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies, risks, and stakeholder relationships while navigating competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and drive decision\-making.
* Experience delivering projects or programmes within the consumer retail domain.
* Familiarity with delivery analytics and forecasting tools such as Plandek, Jira Align, or similar platforms.
* Experience establishing delivery governance frameworks and operating models.
* Relevant Agile or delivery certifications, such as Scrum, AgilePM, PMP, or equivalent.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
 We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
   

  

 And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process — please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.
   

  

**India Benefits**
* Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and dependents, including dental and vision cover, with optional top\-up plans available.
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage based on employee grade.
* Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity and optional National Pension Scheme participation.
* Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation membership and access to wellbeing resources through the dh Wellness Hub.
* Office commute support, internet allowance, Talent Scout referral programme, long service awards and additional family support benefits.
* 25 days annual leave plus public holidays, enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and a day off on your birthday.


**Our approach to Flexible Working**
 At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
   

  

 We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.
   

  

 For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here).

 We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to lead our Digital Process Automation (DPA) initiatives. This role requires close collaboration with the Product Management, Policy Operations, and Content Operations teams to drive innovative automation solutions that enhance operational efficiency, increase revenue, and reduce manual effort. The ideal candidate will also ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into the business unit's (BU) product suite of applications.
   

  

 This role requires leveraging spec\-driven development (an AI\-native development approach) and influencing business stakeholders to align with this approach.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the Product Management and Business Operations teams to identify automation opportunities.
* Oversee the design, development, and deployment of automation solutions with an AI\-first strategy.
* Provide technical direction by leveraging a strong understanding of how AI technologies and generative AI can help solve business challenges, and guide the team in implementing AI\-driven automation.
* Ensure strong collaboration with application development teams to seamlessly integrate automation solutions into the BU's product suite of applications, ensuring scalability and minimal disruption.
* Drive stakeholder management, ensuring effective communication and alignment of automation goals.
* Apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to address complex business challenges.
* Utilize negotiation skills to balance business priorities, technical feasibility, and resource constraints.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in Business Process Automation/Digital Process Automation.

* Experience in stakeholder management, working with cross\-functional teams, and aligning automation initiatives with business goals.
* Strong collaboration skills to ensure automation solutions are effectively integrated into the BU's product suite of applications.
* Strong problem\-solving, negotiation, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.

**JOB DESCRIPTION –Engagement Manager Organic Growth (SEO \& GEO)** 




**Location:** 




 Bangalore \- work on\-site 3 days per week
 



  





**Reports To:** 




 Director \-Engagements
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Engagement Manager – Organic Growth (SEO \& GEO) will lead strategic organic growth engagements for enterprise clients, helping them maximize visibility, customer acquisition, and business outcomes across both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-powered discovery platforms.
 



  





 This individual will serve as the primary client\-facing lead, partnering with clients and internal SEO, Content, Analytics, UX, Data Science, and Technology teams to develop and execute integrated search strategies. The role requires expertise in Enterprise SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Technical SEO, Content Strategy, Search Analytics, AI\-driven search experiences, and digital business strategy.
 



  





 The ideal candidate combines strong consulting and stakeholder management skills with deep search expertise and the ability to translate business challenges into scalable organic growth solutions.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing** 




  





**Client Leadership \& Strategic Advisory** 



* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients on SEO, GEO, search trends, AI\-driven discovery, and evolving search ecosystems.
* Develop organic growth roadmaps aligned to client business objectives, customer acquisition goals, and revenue targets.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders to integrate organic growth strategies into broader digital marketing and business initiatives.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic planning sessions, and executive\-level client discussions.
* Build strong client relationships and become a trusted partner for search and organic growth strategy.



**Organic Growth Strategy (SEO \& GEO)** 



* Lead enterprise SEO and GEO strategies across:
* Technical SEO, Content Strategy \& Optimization, Information Architecture, Authority Building, Entity Optimization, AI Search Visibility, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Develop strategies to improve visibility across: Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity
* Emerging AI\-powered discovery platforms
* Identify growth opportunities through keyword, audience, competitive, market, and search behavior analysis.
* Drive forecasting, opportunity sizing, and business case development for organic growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with content, analytics, and data science teams to create AI\-ready content and scalable search frameworks.



**Analytics \& Problem Solving** 



* Analyze organic traffic, rankings, conversions, engagement metrics, and business KPIs to identify growth opportunities.
* Translate complex business challenges into actionable SEO and GEO strategies.
* Utilize data from: GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, AI\-powered search and content intelligence platforms.
* Conduct SEO/GEO audits and prioritize recommendations based on business impact and implementation effort.
* Present findings, recommendations, and growth opportunities to executive stakeholders.



**Program \& Delivery Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end management of organic growth engagements from strategy through execution and measurement.
* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising SEO specialists, content strategists, developers, UX teams, analytics resources, and data scientists.
* Drive implementation of recommendations and ensure timely delivery against agreed roadmaps.
* Monitor project health, identify risks, and proactively manage stakeholder expectations. Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes including traffic growth, AI search visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue impact.
* Manage client escalations and drive resolution in partnership with delivery teams.



**Commercial \& Account Management** 



* Drive client satisfaction, retention, and long\-term account health.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion, upsell, and cross\-sell of iQuanti capabilities.
* Support proposal development, solutioning discussions, and growth initiatives. Ensure scope, priorities, and client expectations remain aligned throughout the engagement.
* Partner with internal teams to maintain strong delivery quality and commercial performance.



**Team Leadership** 



* Mentor and guide SEO specialists, analysts, and consultants.
* Foster a culture of analytical rigor, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Share best practices across teams and contribute to capability development.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development initiatives



  





**Who You Are** 



* 8–12\+ years of experience in SEO, Organic Growth, Digital Marketing Consulting, or related fields.
* Minimum 5\+ years of experience managing enterprise SEO programs for large websites.
* Strong expertise in Technical SEO, Content Strategy \& Optimization, Site Architecture, Keyword Research, Core Web Vitals, Indexation \& Crawl Optimization, International SEO, and BFSI/E\-commerce SEO.
* Experience managing client\-facing SEO engagements and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills with expertise in GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Experience leading cross\-functional teams and mentoring junior team members.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI\-powered search ecosystems.
* Understanding of Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI search experiences.
* Experience leveraging AI tools for SEO analysis, content optimization, workflow automation, and insight generation.
* Familiarity with entity\-based search, semantic search, and knowledge graph optimization.
* Experience working with enterprise clients in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, or E\-commerce sectors.
* Experience in consulting, digital agencies, or enterprise SEO environments



  





**Desired Qualifications:** 



* MBA from a premier institute (preferred but not mandatory).
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Marketing, or related field.
* SEO certifications from Google, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or equivalent platforms are a plus.



  





**Success Measures** 



* High client satisfaction and retention.
* Growth in organic traffic, conversions, and business impact across managed accounts.
* Improved visibility across both traditional search and AI\-powered discovery platforms.
* Successful adoption of SEO and GEO best practices across client engagements.
* Increased account growth through expansion opportunities.
* Strong stakeholder feedback on strategic thinking, execution quality, and business impact.

**About Us** 




 iQuanti is an independent performance marketing company that generates value for clients by utilizing data to drive better business outcomes through digital channels.  Through a data science\-led approach to client problem\-solving, we've created a differentiated suite of product\-driven service offerings that we deploy to clients, including a search\-predictive efficacy platform called ALPS. We're 350\+ people strong worldwide, with hubs in Jersey City and Bangalore.

3537b3f8.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience partnering with Data Science teams or directly leveraging machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting models, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Experience in network capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or supply\-demand matching.
* Proficiency in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, and data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheet software) to synthesize complex capacity metrics and performance loops.
* Strong foundational knowledge of network infrastructure concepts, including network routing, peering, cache infrastructure (CDN), or capacity placement.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Network Capacity Planner, you will ensure Google Cloud’s growth by guaranteeing network capacity is delivered efficiently and on time to support products and customers. Operating across critical planning and execution horizons, you will blend a deep understanding of network fundamentals with machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting, automate anomaly detection, and simulate complex capacity scenarios.
   

  

 Acting as a key technical collaborator alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers, you will navigate customer requirements, mitigate supply stockouts, and manage inventory buffers. Your work will directly balance resource efficiency with high availability, safeguarding infrastructure performance and driving strategic demand attainment across the global network fleet.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leverage deep knowledge of network fundamentals to understand critical paths, skillfully navigate complex customer requirements, and co\-develop tailored solutions alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers.
* Own the execution window, capturing large agreement requirements and navigating network lead times.
* Build forecasting models leveraging machine learning and AI to improve predictive accuracy, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Mitigate supplies shortages, maintain optimal inventory levels, manage policy\-based buffers, and plan for major peak traffic events.
* Collaborate to build AI\-assisted automation for ordering and resource fulfillment while designing metrics to track fleet efficiency and demand attainment.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c2ce6bad.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
c2ce6bad.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
   

  

 Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Security Solutions Data Science organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager with an understanding of data science who is eager to take on the responsibility of managing a wide variety of data science projects. The person in this role will join a team of leading edge data scientists who are not just building models, but are working to solve fraud related problems for our customers through AI as a foundation for new product offerings.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 The Technical Program Manager will interact with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the organization to deliver complex projects. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and translate technical expressions into business terminology. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 All staff at Mastercard are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day \- own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk\-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager for data science, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:
   

  

* Primary liaison between product and data science, managing day\-to\-day planning and execution of data science projects through the entire engagement process, from business understanding through model deployment and monitoring
* Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the single source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
* Build strong partnerships with product and technology teams and align esnure alignment with data science efforts
* Translate technical approaches and outcomes into business language
* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
* Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
* Work with data scientists and engineering teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
* Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level


**All About You**
 It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.
   

  

* Experience with project management, operating autonomously across multiple teams, with demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning, and building
* Help product, data science and engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. Identify blocking issues and manage their resolution
* Proven track record of data\-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Excellent organization, interpersonal, administrative and problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills at all levels of the organization
* Capable of working independently but with a collaborative nature.
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Imagine being part of a team that is fundamentally changing the way people communicate. Utilizing our differentiated technology, we have created Intelligent Transport Networks with more speed, capacity and scalability than ever before. Imagine a world with unlimited bandwidth. The network of tomorrow will allow for content and creativity limited only by its users' imaginations. If this is something that interests you and you want to be part of what the network will be, come take a look at a team where an idea today can be set in motion tomorrow!
   

  

 Nokia is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead product development programs in a fast\-paced complex multi\-site, multi\-product, multi\-release environment. Tangible results would be measured through improved cross\-functional synergy to deliver innovative products by working with Systems Engineering (ASIC, Hardware, Software, Test/QA), PLM, Architecture \& Technical Support Teams.
   

  

**NILightpath**
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Program Management: Define, plan and execute NPI product development programs across Nokia sites to deliver Optical Transport solutions for ICPs \& CSPs
* Work with PLM, Hardware, Software, Test, Architecture, MFG \& Technical Support to ensure up\-stream (marketing/architecture requirements) and down\-stream (customers \& manufacturing) deliverables are driven, communicated and consensus built with cross functional teams
* Manage and communicate plan of record to product teams and executives. Escalate \& resolve issues effectively
* Drive change control board (CCBs), Metrics \& continuous improvements across R\&D organization

69e24248.title: Program Manager
69e24248.description:
**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Program Manager to coordinate and govern the portfolio of Data Engineering, DevOps, and Platform Engineering initiatives across the enterprise. Rather than running a single project, you'll orchestrate multiple related projects toward broader business outcomes — owning program strategy, delivery governance, intake, financials, and risk. You'll be the bridge between engineering squads and business/leadership stakeholders, ensuring the right work is prioritized, planned, and delivered predictably. Reports into Data \& AI leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Strategy \& Business Alignment:**
* Translate business objectives into a coordinated program roadmap across Data, DevOps, and Platform teams.
* Ensure every initiative ladders up to a measurable business outcome.
* Partner with engineering leads to sequence work, balance capacity, and manage cross\-squad dependencies.


**Multi\-Project Coordination \& Delivery Governance**
* Govern delivery across concurrent projects using NXP's project management methodology.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, and cross\-team ceremonies to keep squads unblocked.
* Run delivery governance — status cadences, milestone tracking, RAID logs, and steering reviews.
* Track program KPIs — predictability, milestone adherence, throughput, and quality.


**Intake Coordination \& Demand Management**
* Own intake for new demand — capturing, triaging, and prioritizing requests into the backlog.
* Coordinate the request desk, ensuring work is assessed, sized, and routed to the right team.
* Translate business requirements (BRD) into epics and user stories with engineering leads.


**Financial \& Resource Management**
* Own program financials — budget planning, tracking, forecasting, and variance management.
* Manage resource allocation and capacity planning and support headcount/vendor planning.


**Risk \& Stakeholder Management**
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks and issues across all workstreams.
* Manage stakeholders across the program lifecycle, communicating progress, trade\-offs, and decisions.
* Provide regular, executive\-ready reports and dashboards to senior management.


**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**
* In your first 6–12 months, you'll establish a clear program governance framework, stand up a reliable intake and prioritization process, improve delivery predictability across squads, and give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and spend.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's/Master's in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or an MBA.
* 8\+ years in project/program management, including multiple concurrent projects and teams.
* Proven experience with Agile delivery and sprint planning in a software/data engineering environment.
* Strong track record in delivery governance — status reporting, milestone tracking, and steering forums.
* Hands\-on experience with intake coordination and demand management for engineering teams.
* Experience with program financials — budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking.
* Strong risk management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Certified project/program management credential (PMP, Prince2, SAFe etc) is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing catalog\-based intake or a service catalog for engineering demand.
* Experience running a request desk / demand management function.
* Ability to translate BRDs into epics and user stories (BRD → Story).
* Familiarity with Data \& AI, Databricks, cloud platforms, or DevOps delivery contexts.
* Working knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow.
* Background in semiconductor, manufacturing, or large\-scale enterprise IT environments is preferred.


**Competencies**
* Outcome orientation — focuses on delivering business outcomes, not just activity.
* Orchestration — coordinates teams, priorities, and dependencies with clarity and calm.
* Governance discipline — brings structure, cadence, and transparency to complex delivery.
* Stakeholder influence — drives alignment across engineering and business without direct authority.
* Clear communication — translates between technical detail and executive messaging.


 More information about NXP in India...

9675ae9f.title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
9675ae9f.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.

 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.  In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. c98b9c41.title: Solutions Specialist, MCU
c98b9c41.description:
**About Us**
 Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.
   

  

 Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.
   

  

 Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.
   

  

 We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Qt for MCUs is on a mission to bring Qt’s industry\-leading UI framework to the most resource\-constrained microcontrollers on the market — enabling rich, responsive user experiences on devices where every byte of Flash and every millisecond of CPU time matters. Our team works directly with the world’s leading silicon vendors and embedded product companies to make that vision a reality.
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer — MCU, you are the technical heart of our customer engagements. You will port Qt for MCUs to new silicon platforms, design display adaptation layers, solve complex hardware\-software integration challenges, and serve as the go\-to subject matter expert for MCU\-related opportunities across sales, pre\-sales, and product engineering.
   

  

 This role is located in Bengaluru, India.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Port Qt for MCUs to new microcontroller platforms — from BSP bring\-up and HAL integration through to display adaptation, framebuffer management, and validated performance on target hardware
* Design and optimise display and graphics pipelines for memory\-constrained MCUs, including DMA\-driven transfers, partial rendering, and asset optimisation using the Qt for MCUs toolchain
* Act as the primary technical SME for customer engagements, proof\-of\-concept projects, and evaluations — delivering workshops, demos, and training to engineering teams worldwide
* Debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, BSP, and UI stack layers using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes; provide root\-cause analysis and drive resolution with product engineering
* Author application notes, porting guides, and best\-practice documentation; support the sales team with technical proposals and RFP responses for Qt for MCUs solutions
* Collaborate closely with silicon vendors (Infineon, Renesas, NXP, STMicroelectronics) and internal engineering teams to bridge cutting\-edge Qt technology with real\-world MCU constraints


**What You Bring To The Table**
* 5–8 years of hands\-on embedded software engineering experience with a strong focus on microcontroller\-based products and ARM Cortex\-M class devices (STM32, NXP i.MX RT, Renesas RA/RH)
* Proven experience porting or adapting embedded software stacks in bare\-metal and RTOS environments (FreeRTOS and/or Zephyr), with a solid grasp of MCU memory architecture
* Hands\-on experience with TFT/LCD display integration: framebuffer management, pixel format handling, display controller configuration, and serial protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, DMA)
* Experience with at least one embedded GUI framework — Qt for MCUs, LVGL, Embedded Wizard, or STemWin — and proficiency in C and C\+\+ with CMake\-based build systems
* Strong communication skills in English; ability to translate deep technical knowledge into clear guidance for both engineering and commercial audiences


**Bonus Points For…**
* Experience with additional MCU families (ESP32/Espressif, PIC/Microchip) or silicon vendor BSP ecosystems such as STM32CubeIDE, MCUXpresso, e2studio, or ModusToolbox
* Prior Solutions Engineering, Field Application Engineering, or other customer\-facing technical role experience
* Familiarity with Qt Widgets or Qt Quick/QML on higher\-powered targets, and/or contributions to open\-source embedded or GUI projects


**Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.**
 We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.
   

  

* Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
* Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
* Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands\-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
* Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
* Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.


**Bring Your Whole Self**
 The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.
   

  

 We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.
   

  

**We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.**

d27a22e4.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Generative AI
d27a22e4.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting\-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG\-based workflows.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Architect end\-to\-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language\-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre\-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language\-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG\-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG\-based solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In\-depth understanding of state\-of\-the\-art language models, including but not limited to GPT\-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine\-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

d4d6d0c6.title: Solution Architect
d4d6d0c6.description:
About Vorro
 



 Vorro is an enterprise data integration company and the creator of the BridgeGate Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS). BridgeGate uses a patented any\-to\-any integration technology, with visual mapping and workflow orchestration, to connect applications, business processes and external trading partners without the cost of custom interface development.
 



 Vorro has been deployed in over 100 enterprise environments across healthcare, retail, insurance, logistics and specialty networks, with particular depth in healthcare, where BridgeGate helps payers, providers, EMR vendors, HIEs and pharmacies exchange clinical and financial data using standards such as HL7, CCD/CCDA and FHIR. Alongside the platform, Vorro offers fully managed integration services, taking ownership of data interfacing and partner coordination on customers’ behalf.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical design and solution roadmap for Vorro customer engagements built on BridgeGate. This is a customer\-facing role: you will translate multi\-system integration requirements into clear architectures, define phased implementation roadmaps, and govern delivery against them from discovery through production rollout.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Solution Architecture and Design** 



* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for integration engagements on BridgeGate, covering integration patterns, data flow, interface design, security and scalability.
* Run discovery workshops to capture business processes, source and target systems, data formats and compliance needs, and convert these into documented technical requirements.
* Design any\-to\-any integration solutions across applications, EMRs, HIEs, payer systems, trading partners and internal enterprise systems, defining the data mapping and transformation logic involved.
* Produce and maintain solution design documents, interface specifications and data flow diagrams, and design for throughput, availability, error handling and monitoring.



**Solution Roadmapping** 



* Build robust, phased solution roadmaps for each engagement, covering current state, target state, milestones, dependencies and sequencing.
* Maintain and revise the roadmap through the engagement as scope or priorities shift, and run regular checkpoints with customer and internal leadership on progress.
* Define migration roadmaps for customers moving off legacy interface engines onto BridgeGate, and scalability roadmaps so delivered solutions can absorb new partners and volumes without re\-architecture.
* Feed capability gaps identified in customer roadmaps back to Product and Engineering.



**Pre\-Sales and Customer Engagement** 



* Support sales with technical discovery, solution positioning, architecture walkthroughs and proof of concept.
* Contribute solution design, estimates and delivery roadmap to RFPs, proposals and statements of work.
* Act as trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, from integration analysts to CIOs.



**Delivery Governance** 



* Govern implementation against the approved architecture and roadmap through design reviews and go\-live readiness checks.
* Provide technical guidance to integration developers and support engineers through build, testing and deployment.
* Lead resolution of escalated technical issues in production\-critical integrations, and ensure solutions meet security, compliance and audit requirements.



 Required Qualifications and Skills
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field.
* 7 to 10 years of total IT experience, including at least 2 years in a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or Integration Architect capacity.
* Hands\-on background with integration platforms, interface engines, ESB or iPaaS technologies, and API design.
* Working knowledge of data formats and protocols: XML, JSON, EDI, flat file, REST, SOAP, SFTP and messaging systems.
* Demonstrated experience building and owning solution roadmaps, including phasing, milestones and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong data mapping and transformation expertise across systems with no common standard.
* Good understanding of cloud/hybrid deployment, and experience designing for security and compliance in regulated environments.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customers in a pre\-sales or delivery capacity.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with healthcare interoperability standards: HL7 v2, CCD/CCDA, FHIR, X12 EDI.
* Experience integrating EMR, EHR, HIE, pharmacy or payer systems, and familiarity with HIPAA requirements.
* Cloud or architecture certifications such as AWS, Azure or TOGAF.
* Experience working with US\-based customers and partial overlap with US time zones.



 What We Offer
 


* Ownership of the architecture and roadmap for enterprise integration programmes with measurable business impact.
* Exposure to a patented integration platform and complex, standards\-driven interoperability problems.
* Direct engagement with senior customer stakeholders and a path to principal or practice leadership roles.
