3e842c6f.title: Senior Consultant - F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) 6 months Contract
3e842c6f.description:
**6\-Month Contract (C2C / Fixed\-Term) · Bengaluru or Hyderabad, India**


Enterprise clients across India are racing to lock down multi\-cloud APIs, applications, and connectivity — and they need someone who can walk in and own F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) delivery from day one. This isn't a support\-desk role. You'll be the technical owner of complex, mission\-critical F5 XC deployments for enterprise customers, working alongside C\-Serv's global F5 practice.

**What you'll own**

* Design and deploy F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) solutions across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments
* Deliver secure application networking, API protection (WAAP), and DDoS mitigation for mission\-critical platforms
* Automate provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Ansible
* Act as the client's primary technical point of contact — proactive support, not reactive ticket\-clearing

  

**Requirements** **What you'll need**

* Hands\-on F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) experience, or deep F5 BIG\-IP / WAAP / API security experience with the ability to ramp fast
* Strong networking and security fundamentals — BGP, DNS, IPSec, firewalls, routing
* Kubernetes and cloud\-native (AWS/Azure/GCP) exposure
* **You must be based in, or able to relocate immediately to, Bengaluru or Hyderabad, and work from the client office five days a week for the full six months.** This is not a remote or hybrid engagement — please don't apply if you can't commit to on\-site presence in one of these two cities.
* Open to either a C2C arrangement (own registered entity) or engagement as a fixed\-term employee

  

**Benefits** **What you'll get**

* A high\-visibility six\-month engagement with strong extension potential
* Direct ownership of a client relationship, not a back\-seat delivery role
* C\-Serv's backing — a delivery partner with a real F5 practice, not a staffing pass\-through

**Apply now** if you can be on\-site in Bengaluru or Hyderabad and want to own F5 XC delivery end to end.

b0fbc556.title: Workday Solution Architect
b0fbc556.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Responsibilities:


* Define and govern Workday solution architecture.
* Assess business requirements and design scalable solutions.
* Lead complex enhancements, integrations, and transformation initiatives.
* Provide architectural guidance for Workday ecosystem and interfaces.
* Review and approve configuration and design changes.
* Support incident escalations and critical production issues.
* Drive application performance, security, and stability improvements.
* Ensure compliance with architecture standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with customer stakeholders, delivery teams, and vendors.
* Mentor functional and technical consultants.

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Skills \& Qualifications


* 10\+ years experience in Workday architecture and solution design.
* Expertise across multiple Workday modules.
* Experience with Workday integrations, security, reporting, and extensibility.
* Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture.
* Experience with cloud\-based SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of AMS delivery, ITIL processes, and governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience


* Master's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

 Job Category

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The Senior Technical Consultant — Agentforce Revenue Cloud Management is a hands\-on delivery specialist responsible for executing the CPQ configuration, billing setup, data migration and Agentforce agent implementation workstreams within Revenue Cloud migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns specific delivery workstreams end\-to\-end — including Salesforce CPQ product catalogue configuration, pricing rule builds, contract and subscription data migration, billing schedule setup, ERP integration development and Agentforce revenue agent configuration. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants and ensures factory quality standards are met across all Revenue Cloud deliverables.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute Salesforce CPQ configuration — building product catalogue structures, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, price books, guided selling configurations, approval process setups, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic as specified in the Technical Architect's CPQ solution design.
* Execute product catalogue and pricing data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle for CPQ objects: loading products, price book entries, pricing tiers, bundle configurations and discount structures using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines — validating record counts and pricing logic post\-load.
* Migrate active contracts and subscription records — transforming legacy contract records to Salesforce object schema, loading Contract, Subscription, Asset and Order objects, preserving relationship integrity and validating amendment/renewal eligibility post\-migration.
* Configure Salesforce Billing — setting up billing schedules, invoice templates, payment terms, usage\-based billing configurations, tax engine integration settings and dunning workflow automation as directed by the TA.
* Develop Apex components for Revenue Cloud migration — writing Batch Apex for bulk CPQ/Billing data migration, SBQQ plugin override classes, custom price calculation triggers, quote calculation hooks and REST callout adapters for ERP integration.
* Implement Agentforce revenue agents — configuring Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard and custom Apex actions for revenue use cases (quote\-assist, renewal agents, deal desk agents) as specified in the Solution Architect's agent blueprint.
* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing LWC dashboards, Salesforce Flow orchestrations and Apex batch utilities for CPQ quote validation, contract record reconciliation and billing schedule verification.
* Develop ERP integration components — building REST/SOAP callout adapters and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing\-to\-ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) data flows as directed by the Technical Architect.
* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating CPQ and billing data migration dry runs: loading data into SIT/UAT environments, validating pricing rule outputs, confirming billing schedule generation and iterating to dry run sign\-off.
* Support go\-live cutover execution — executing final CPQ/Billing data loads, validating product catalogue integrity, confirming active contract migration completeness and activating Agentforce agents.
* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing CPQ configuration workbooks, pricing rule documentation, contract migration mapping sheets and Agentforce agent configuration guides for client team handover.
* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC CPQ configuration and data migration work, explaining Revenue Cloud platform patterns and unblocking technical issues aligned to factory standards.
* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating CPQ config templates, pricing rule patterns, contract migration scripts, Agentforce prompt and action libraries and billing validation tools.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ) — Hands\-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Salesforce CPQ end\-to\-end — products, price books, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, bundle configuration, guided selling, approval workflows, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic.
* Salesforce Billing Configuration: Hands\-on experience configuring Salesforce Billing — billing schedules, invoice generation, usage\-based billing, payment terms, tax engine integration and dunning workflows.
* CPQ \& Billing Data Migration Execution: Demonstrated experience loading high\-volume CPQ and Billing objects — Products, PricebookEntries, Contracts, Subscriptions, Assets, Orders — using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines.
* Agentforce Configuration: Working knowledge of Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard actions and custom Apex actions — sufficient to implement revenue agent blueprints defined by the Solution Architect.
* Apex \& Platform Development: Solid Apex development skills — Batch Apex for CPQ/Billing data migration, Schedulable classes, SBQQ plugin overrides, Apex trigger frameworks, REST callout adapters for ERP integration and Apex test classes.
* Lightning Web Components \& Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, CPQ validation UIs and Salesforce Flow orchestrations as internal factory tooling.
* ERP Integration Development: Experience developing REST/SOAP callout handlers and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing\-to\-ERP (SAP, Oracle or NetSuite) integration.
* ETL Tools \& Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory) for extracting and transforming legacy CPQ, contract and billing data.
* Data Architecture — CPQ Objects: Understanding of Salesforce CPQ data model — Quote, Quote Line, Product, Price Book, Contract, Subscription, Asset, Order and Billing object relationships.
* CI/CD \& Source Control: Comfortable in Salesforce DX and Git\-based workflows — committing Apex code and CPQ metadata, following branching conventions and using Gearset/Copado.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Experience migrating from Apttus/Conga CPQ, Zuora, Oracle CPQ or Salesforce Classic CPQ (Big Machines) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud
* Knowledge of Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) — dynamic revenue contracts and flexible pricing model configuration
* of Salesforce Subscription Management for direct\-to\-consumer billing model configuration
* Experience with multi\-currency CPQ configuration and multi\-entity billing setups for global enterprise clients
* Knowledge of payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Zuora) at the implementation level


**Experience Requirements**
* 5–8 years of Salesforce platform delivery experience with a focus on CPQ, billing and revenue operations
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce CPQ configuration experience across at least 2 CPQ implementations or migrations
* Demonstrated experience executing CPQ and contract data migrations — loading Products, Contracts, Subscriptions and Assets with relationship integrity at scale
* Hands\-on Apex development experience — particularly Batch Apex for data migration, SBQQ plugin overrides and REST callout adapters

**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders \- and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
   

  

 We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better \- a product, a process, a career \- you'll fit right in.
   

  

 At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Kaseya is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead high\-impact, cross\-platform technical programs that span multiple SaaS products, engineering organizations, and business functions. In this role, you will operate as a force multiplier for engineering and product leadership, driving execution rigor, dependency management, and delivery predictability across complex initiatives such as platform integrations, modernization efforts, reliability improvements, and enterprise\-scale launches. This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Program Leadership \& Delivery
   

  

* Own and drive end\-to\-end execution of large, cross\-functional technical programs impacting multiple Kaseya products and platforms
* Translate company\-level priorities into clear program plans, milestones, success metrics, and delivery commitments
* Actively manage scope, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Ensure programs are delivered with high quality, security, and reliability standards appropriate for MSP and enterprise customers


 Technical \& Architectural Partnership
   

  

* Partner closely with engineering leaders and architects to understand system design, platform constraints, and technical risks
* Drive alignment on architecture decisions, sequencing, and integration strategies, especially across acquired products
* Develop technical fluency across Kaseya's SaaS platforms, APIs, data flows, and cloud infrastructure


 Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Serve as the single\-threaded owner for program health, communicating clearly with senior engineering, product, and executive leaders
* Produce crisp executive\-level updates that highlight progress, risks, mitigation plans, and decision points
* Facilitate decision\-making across organizations with competing priorities and limited resources


 Operational Excellence \& Scale
   

  

* Establish scalable program management frameworks, operating rhythms, and tooling to support Kaseya's growth
* Identify systemic execution gaps and drive improvements in planning, dependency management, and delivery predictability
* Mentor and influence other TPMs, helping raise the bar for technical program management across the organization


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, or equivalent roles in SaaS or cloud\-based software environments
* Strong technical foundation with the ability to engage deeply in architecture, APIs, data, and cloud\-native systems
* Proven experience leading multi\-team, multi\-product programs with significant technical and organizational complexity
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in a fast\-paced, matrixed organization


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working on platform integration, M\&A integration, or large\-scale SaaS modernization initiatives
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), distributed systems, and enterprise\-grade security requirements
* Experience supporting B2B, IT management, security, or MSP\-focused products
* Strong working knowledge of Agile and hybrid delivery models
* Prior experience mentoring TPMs or acting as a program leader across multiple initiatives


**Additional Information**
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

2390e7ea.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
2390e7ea.description:
**Overview**
 Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world\-class security and compliance.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single\-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi\-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid\-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.
   

  

 You will own two initiatives end to end.
 **Scale** 
 is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group\-level administration, and standing up an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time.
 **Access automation** 
 is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.
   

  

 We need an AI Native, results\-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive Technical Excellence: Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi\-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi\-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
* Own the Scale Initiative: Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re\-emerge with an end\-to\-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
* Own the Access Automation Initiative: Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
* Connect Strategy to Execution: Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest\-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow\-through with stakeholders.
* Execute with Rigor: Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end\-to\-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
* Own Risks and Dependencies: Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
* Identity Architecture Partnership: Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
* Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption: Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
* Enable Scale and Velocity: Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI\-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human\-generated output.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high\-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
* Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
* Identity Platform Depth: Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product\-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
* Access Model Fluency: Working knowledge of role\- and attribute\-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over\-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
* Multi\-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling: Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross\-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
* Technical Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end\-to\-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API\-first delivery, including developer\-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
* Scale Judgment: Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small\-customer design point to a large\-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
* AI\-Native Delivery: Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
* Leadership Style: Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self\-starter who values "Leadership as a Coach" and supports the growth of those around you.
* Communication: Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
* Analytical Skills: Strong data\-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
* Preferred: Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid\-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional\-services channels.


 Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

e5ce9dd0.title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
e5ce9dd0.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
   

  

 As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
   

  

 In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


 Regional travel up to 35%.

2d5ed5c6.description:
**Job Description – Business Process Reengineering (BPR) Consultant**

 **Position:** Senior Consultant

 **Experience:** 3–10 Years

 **Qualification:** Graduate (Any Discipline) / B.E./B.Tech / MBA

 **Location:** As per project requirements

 **Role Overview**

  

The selected candidate will support Government transformation and e\-Governance projects by conducting Business Process Reengineering (BPR) studies, documenting existing ("As\-Is") processes, designing improved ("To\-Be") processes, assessing technology adequacy, and recommending process and digital transformation initiatives.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Conduct detailed **As\-Is process study**, stakeholder consultations, and process mapping for Government departments and agencies.
* Prepare **BPR reports**, process documentation, SOPs, workflows, and process improvement recommendations.
* Design and document **To\-Be processes** aligned with service delivery, efficiency, and governance objectives.
* Assess existing technology landscape, applications, and digital infrastructure for **technology adequacy and gap analysis**.
* Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, workflow optimization, and citizen\-centric service improvements.
* Support requirement gathering, business analysis, and preparation of functional specifications.
* Facilitate workshops, stakeholder discussions, and validation sessions with Government officials and other stakeholders.
* Develop presentations, reports, and implementation roadmaps for process transformation initiatives.
* Support project management and change management activities as required.

 **Desired Skills**

  

* Experience in **Business Process Reengineering (BPR), Business Analysis, Process Mapping, or Process Improvement** projects.
* Knowledge of Government/e\-Governance projects, digital transformation initiatives, or consulting assignments.
* Familiarity with process modeling tools such as Visio, BPMN, or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to prepare high\-quality reports, frameworks, and presentations.

 **Preferred Experience**

* Experience in State/Central Government, PSU, Digital Governance, or public sector consulting projects.
* Exposure to technology assessment, enterprise transformation, or digital modernization initiatives.

 **Experience Range:** 3–10 years

 **Education:** Graduate / B.E./B.Tech / MBA from a recognized institution.

Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

 As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.

* Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement Cloud Resources: Oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.

* Automate Processes: Use automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.

 Master's Degree

* Cloud Services Proficiency: Experience with cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, along with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* DevOps Practices: Experience with DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), and applying these practices to cloud infrastructure management.
* Automation Tools: Experience using automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, and ability to manage and execute cloud migration plans.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.

* Cloud Security Best Practices: Experience with implementing and enforcing cloud security measures to ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations, including data encryption, access controls, and threat detection.
* Advanced Cloud Automation: Experience with advanced automation tools and scripting languages, such as Python or PowerShell, to automate complex cloud infrastructure tasks and workflows.

Job Description Overview:
   

  

 Accenture's Data \& AI practice empowers global enterprises to modernize data foundations, scale generative and agentic AI, and achieve measurable business reinvention. Its end\-to\-end capabilities span data platform modernization, cloud migration of legacy data estates, development of cutting\-edge AI and Gen AI solutions, and production support of AI \& Data applications.
   

  

 You Are: \[DMS \- Data Managed Services SA]
   

  

 As a Data Managed Services Presales Solution Architect, you will lead the end\-to\-end solution blueprint and roadmap, acting as the bridge between client vision and technology execution. You will be instrumental in translating business problems into technology solutions and having stakeholder alignment throughout the deal lifecycle. In this role, you’ll gain experience in designing Data \& AI application maintenance and support solutions, working across global delivery and sales teams. You will work cross clouds, cross industry cross geography giving depth and breadth of exposure.  You’ll also deepen your expertise in emerging technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, Gen AI, Agents —preparing you for the future.
   

  

 The Work:
   

  

 Understand RFP/RFIs and translate the business needs into technical architecture (data engineering, data visualization, AI, Gen AI).
   

  

 Understand end\-to\-end application architectures diagrams (data ingestion to data consumption to AI/ML).
   

  

 Map technology components (e.g. Informatica, Power BI, PySpark, Azure ML, Azure Foundry, GCP BigQuery, AWS Glue, Snowflake, Databricks etc.) with business use cases.
   

  

 Prepare detailed ADM effort estimates for application maintenance and enhancements and get them validated with AI \& Data capability SMEs.
   

  

 Design optimal staffing models based on onshore/offshore/nearshore mix and pyramid structure.
   

  

 Build solution plan power point decks for use in sales and delivery alignment.
   

  

 Engage in solution and delivery reviews with leadership across geographies.
   

  

 Act as the strategic link between sales and delivery teams.
   

  

 Contribute to client\-facing proposals, SOWs, and contracting documents.
   

  

 Present and defend your solution in internal and external forums.
   

  

 Seamlessly transition the solution to the delivery team post\-deal closure.
   

  

 Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on business need and client requirements.
   

  

 Here’s What You Need:
   

  

 Must Have: Strong Data engineering or Business intelligence or AI/Gen AI experience in application maintenance projects
   

  

 Working knowledge of cloud ecosystems – Azure or AWS, or Google Cloud.
   

  

 Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, filters, vlookup etc.).
   

  

 Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
   

  

 Experience working in cross\-functional and global environments.
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 12 years of relevant IT industry experience in AI \& Data delivery or Presales
   

  

 Location: Any city having Accenture office.
   

  

 Education: 15 years of full\-time education required.
   

  

 Bonus Points If you have:
   

  

 Good PowerPoint skills for leadership and client storytelling.
   

  

 External client\-facing experience

92d97396.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
   

  

 You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Excellent active listening skills, confirming understanding and seeking relevant information.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**Job Profile**

The Information Security Services Team is seeking an Information Security Product \& Service Delivery Specialist – Global Security Operations to drive the delivery and execution of cybersecurity services across the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) Center of Excellence. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery of core GSOC services—including log ingestion, use case development, threat detection, and incident response operations—across all regions. The specialist will lead cross\-functional coordination, manage operational performance metrics, and ensure service delivery aligns with enterprise risk objectives, governance standards, and evolving global requirements.


**What You'll Do**

* Lead the development, tuning, and governance of GSOC use cases to improve detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and address emerging threat vectors.
* Manage cross\-functional programs from initiation through delivery, ensuring milestones are met and outcomes are communicated effectively to stakeholders across regions.
* Develop and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and service\-level metrics that reflect operational health, risk appetite, and residual risk—enabling transparent reporting to senior leadership and governance bodies.
* Partners with cybersecurity, risk, and control teams to coordinate remediation efforts, track progress, and resolve operational gaps in service delivery.
* Facilitate process improvement initiatives and stakeholder engagement to identify inefficiencies and drive enhancements across GSOC workflows and service operations.
* Conduct end\-to\-end service delivery evaluations, prioritizing improvement opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment.
* Integrate industry frameworks, best practices, and regulatory requirements into GSOC operational workflows to ensure compliance and adaptability across jurisdictions.
* Monitor developments in cybersecurity programs, regulatory landscapes, and internal organizational changes that influence GSOC service execution and reporting.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience also considered.
* 10\-12 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, security service delivery, program management, or risk management, ideally within financial services.
* Hands\-on familiarity with GSOC functions such as log ingestion, SIEM operations, use case development, threat detection, and incident response workflows.
* Proven experience in strategic planning, program execution, and executive\-level reporting.
* Knowledge of models/frameworks such as Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT\&CK

* Demonstrated creative problem\-solving abilities
* Experience creating trending, metrics, and management reports
* Skilled in developing briefing materials, managing logistics, and facilitating cross\-functional collaboration across global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive operational efficiency through technology and process innovation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for technical and non\-technical audiences.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Japanese corporate environments or proficiency in Japanese.
* Experience managing global, cross\-cultural teams and coordinating service delivery across multiple regions.
* Broad exposure across cybersecurity domains (governance, risk, network security, threat/vulnerability management, incident response).
* Familiarity with automation, AI, or light scripting for reporting and operational efficiency.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security\+, ISSMP, SANS, GSEC, GCFA, GNFA, GIAC and/or GCIH)
* Knowledge in one or more security domains including Security Governance and Oversight, Security Risk Management, Network Security, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response and Forensics
* Experience with cloud computing security, network, operating system, database, application, and mobile device security.

* Provide leadership for global SAP application delivery across major transformation workstreams, including S/4HANA migration, integration, modernization, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish architecture direction for enterprise SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SuccessFactors, HCM, and related non\-SAP platforms.
* Provide delivery governance, technical decision leadership, and direction across matrixed global teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders.

  


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Delivery \& Program Management**


* Develop and manage SAP technical delivery plans across global programs, with accountability for execution quality, milestone discipline, and alignment to business outcomes.
* Lead technical workstreams responsible for custom development, integrations, environments, deployments, production readiness, and stabilization.
* Define release strategy, cutover approach, governance routines, escalation pathways, and delivery risk mitigation plans.

  


**SAP Architecture \& Integration**


* Design scalable SAP architecture patterns that support Clean Core principles, extensibility, integration reuse, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Provide architecture leadership across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, APIs, IDocs, and non\-SAP integrations.
* Support modernization decisions that reduce technical debt, improve platform resilience, and enable enterprise\-scale SAP transformation outcomes.

  


**Application Development \& Support**


* Oversee SAP application design, build, testing, deployment, and support with clear quality gates and accountability across delivery teams.
* Lead technical reviews, performance analysis, defect triage, root\-cause resolution, and production readiness assessments for critical SAP capabilities.
* Ensure production support and warranty operations meet business continuity, service quality, and incident resolution expectations.

  


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**


* Partner with business leaders, technology executives, vendors, and delivery teams to align architecture decisions with program objectives and enterprise standards.
* Lead executive\-level solution reviews, requirement alignment sessions, technical steering discussions, and delivery status communications.
* Address escalations, change impacts, architectural trade\-offs, and delivery commitments through clear ownership and evidence\-based decision making.

  


**Leadership \& People Management**


* Lead matrixed global delivery teams across architecture, development, integration, testing, deployment, and support functions.
* Develop technical talent, strengthen delivery standards, and promote reusable methods, knowledge sharing, and architecture discipline across teams.

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**



The role requires sound judgment across architecture, delivery, risk, and stakeholder decisions in a matrixed global environment. The candidate will be expected to evaluate trade\-offs across SAP S/4HANA, integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core, security, performance, and delivery timelines while making evidence\-based decisions that protect business outcomes and enterprise standards.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


* 15\+ years of SAP technology experience, including senior accountability for technical delivery, architecture governance, and global transformation execution.
* Proven experience across full\-cycle SAP implementations, S/4HANA migrations, global rollouts, and complex application modernization programs.
* Deep understanding of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, event\-driven integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core principles, and side\-by\-side extensibility.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and related enterprise compliance requirements.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and leadership skills in matrixed global environments.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**



The role will provide technical leadership and delivery direction across matrixed global teams, including architects, developers, integration specialists, testing teams, vendors, and support resources. Responsibilities include coaching senior technical talent, strengthening architecture and delivery practices, and developing reusable capabilities that improve execution quality across programs.

  


**Other Requirements:**



Travel may be required up to 10% based on business needs.

  


**Job Requirements:**


**To qualify, candidates must have:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years in SAP technical roles, including 5\+ years leading application delivery, architecture, integration, or development teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration, global rollout, integration, cutover, and stabilization responsibilities.
* Hands\-on knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensibility, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and enterprise compliance\-related SAP capabilities.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, vendors, and global delivery teams.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.


* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.
* Flexible work arrangements: EY flexible work policies are designed to support balance, trust, and autonomy, subject to business and role requirements.
* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.
* Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential performance\-based incentives.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Summary**
 Sr Architect for Salesforce Agentforce responsible for designing scalable secure and resilient customer service solutions that align with enterprise standards and business goals in a hybrid work model using deep platform expertise to optimize performance improve agent productivity and deliver measurable value for clients and society.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design end to end Salesforce Agentforce solutions that align with enterprise architecture principles and meet complex customer service requirements across multiple business units.
* Translate business needs into detailed Salesforce configurations and integrations that improve agent efficiency response accuracy and overall customer satisfaction.
* Create high level and low level technical designs for Service Cloud and Agentforce capabilities that ensure scalability resilience security and ease of maintenance.
* Collaborate with product owners business analysts and delivery teams to refine user stories and ensure technical feasibility and value driven outcomes for every feature.
* Define integration patterns between Salesforce and external applications using best practice approaches that ensure reliable data flow consistent experiences and robust error handling.
* Review configurations and customizations implemented by development teams to ensure adherence to architecture standards coding guidelines and performance expectations.
* Optimize Salesforce Agentforce features such as routing console layouts and agent workflows to reduce handling time and improve operational metrics for service teams.
* Guide the selection and usage of Salesforce automation capabilities including flows assignment rules and macros to reduce manual effort and enhance quality.
* Monitor system performance identify bottlenecks and propose improvements that enhance stability response time and user experience without adding unnecessary complexity.
* Document architecture decisions solution designs and configuration patterns in a clear structured manner to support future maintenance reuse and audit readiness.
* Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to ensure that all Salesforce implementations follow organizational policies regulatory requirements and data protection standards.
* Coordinate with testing teams to define test strategies coverage and scenarios that validate functional behavior integration reliability and performance of Salesforce solutions.
* Provide technical mentorship to peers and junior architects by sharing best practices reusable patterns and practical guidance that elevate overall team capability.
* Engage with business partners to evaluate new Salesforce Agentforce features and app exchange offerings to continuously improve service capabilities and innovation potential.
* Participate in production support reviews by analyzing incidents and proposing sustainable design changes that reduce recurrence and enhance platform robustness.
* Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned from projects and refining architecture blueprints and reference models for future Salesforce initiatives.
* Align solution roadmaps with broader digital transformation objectives so that Salesforce investments deliver measurable benefits to customers and society through better service outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Require a minimum of ten years of overall IT experience with at least eight years focused on Salesforce implementations across service and customer engagement domains.
* Require proven hands on experience in Salesforce Service Cloud and Agentforce including configuration of consoles omni channel routing and case management capabilities.
* Require strong knowledge of Salesforce data modeling sharing models security configuration and performance tuning tailored for high volume service operations.
* Require practical experience designing integrations using tools such as middleware platforms rest based interfaces and event driven patterns in enterprise environments.
* Require demonstrated ability to work in hybrid teams manage multiple stakeholders and communicate complex technical concepts in clear business friendly language.
* Nice to have experience with additional Salesforce clouds such as experience cloud and field service that complement Agentforce centric solutions.
* Nice to have exposure to agile delivery practices with participation in sprint planning backlog refinement and continuous delivery pipelines for Salesforce programs.
* Nice to have familiarity with industry specific service processes in sectors such as financial services retail or telecom to better adapt Salesforce solutions to domain needs.
* Nice to have background in user experience design principles as applied to Salesforce consoles to create intuitive and productive workspaces for service agents.


**Certifications Required**
 Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant or Salesforce Certified Application Architect preferred.

2c373643.title: ET BMC - MarTech Solution Architect
2c373643.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Discipline:** 
 Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC)
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 ET BMC \- MarTech Solution Architect
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.
   

  

 The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target\-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data\-driven and AI\-enabled future.
   

  

 The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI\-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target\-state architecture.
* Develop future\-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Assess the current landscape and define transition\-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi\-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify cross\-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
* Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision\-making.
* Translate strategic business needs into end\-to\-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long\-term sustainability.
* Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP\-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
* Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
* Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI\-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
* Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI\-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
* Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
* Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
* Promote API\-first, event\-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
* Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade\-offs in clear, business\-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, identity and consent.
* Strong architecture modelling capabilities across business, capability, data, application, integration and technology domains.
* Proven experience producing current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, transition\-state designs and migration strategies.
* Experience developing multi\-year transformation roadmaps and working with Product Managers to convert architectural direction into sequenced delivery plans.
* Ability to translate executive objectives and business outcomes into actionable architecture, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading architecture across complex transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, products and business functions.
* Knowledge of emerging AI architecture patterns, including agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, retrieval architectures and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation opportunities into pragmatic architecture and product roadmaps.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with experience supporting business cases, option assessments, vendor evaluations and investment decisions.
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, privacy, security and AI enablement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent, with relevant cloud certification desirable.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, MS Dynamics, CDPs, DAM or comparable enterprise platforms.


**Typical architecture outputs**
* Current\-state and target\-state architecture views.
* Transition\-state architecture and migration approaches.
* Business capability maps, maturity assessments and heat maps.
* Multi\-year architecture and technology transformation roadmaps.
* Solution blueprints, integration architectures and data flow models.
* AI agent, orchestration and MCP\-enabled integration architecture patterns.
* Architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Solution option assessments, architecture decision records and investment recommendations.
* Dependency, risk, technical debt and sequencing views that support portfolio and product planning.
