a0dbe060.title: Senior Technical Consultant -Migration-Revenue Cloud/Marketing Cloud
a0dbe060.description:
**Description**
 The Senior Technical Consultant — Agentforce Revenue Cloud Management is a hands\-on delivery specialist responsible for executing the CPQ configuration, billing setup, data migration and Agentforce agent implementation workstreams within Revenue Cloud migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns specific delivery workstreams end\-to\-end — including Salesforce CPQ product catalogue configuration, pricing rule builds, contract and subscription data migration, billing schedule setup, ERP integration development and Agentforce revenue agent configuration. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants and ensures factory quality standards are met across all Revenue Cloud deliverables.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute Salesforce CPQ configuration — building product catalogue structures, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, price books, guided selling configurations, approval process setups, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic as specified in the Technical Architect's CPQ solution design.
* Execute product catalogue and pricing data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle for CPQ objects: loading products, price book entries, pricing tiers, bundle configurations and discount structures using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines — validating record counts and pricing logic post\-load.
* Migrate active contracts and subscription records — transforming legacy contract records to Salesforce object schema, loading Contract, Subscription, Asset and Order objects, preserving relationship integrity and validating amendment/renewal eligibility post\-migration.
* Configure Salesforce Billing — setting up billing schedules, invoice templates, payment terms, usage\-based billing configurations, tax engine integration settings and dunning workflow automation as directed by the TA.
* Develop Apex components for Revenue Cloud migration — writing Batch Apex for bulk CPQ/Billing data migration, SBQQ plugin override classes, custom price calculation triggers, quote calculation hooks and REST callout adapters for ERP integration.
* Implement Agentforce revenue agents — configuring Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard and custom Apex actions for revenue use cases (quote\-assist, renewal agents, deal desk agents) as specified in the Solution Architect's agent blueprint.
* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing LWC dashboards, Salesforce Flow orchestrations and Apex batch utilities for CPQ quote validation, contract record reconciliation and billing schedule verification.
* Develop ERP integration components — building REST/SOAP callout adapters and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing\-to\-ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) data flows as directed by the Technical Architect.
* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating CPQ and billing data migration dry runs: loading data into SIT/UAT environments, validating pricing rule outputs, confirming billing schedule generation and iterating to dry run sign\-off.
* Support go\-live cutover execution — executing final CPQ/Billing data loads, validating product catalogue integrity, confirming active contract migration completeness and activating Agentforce agents.
* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing CPQ configuration workbooks, pricing rule documentation, contract migration mapping sheets and Agentforce agent configuration guides for client team handover.
* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC CPQ configuration and data migration work, explaining Revenue Cloud platform patterns and unblocking technical issues aligned to factory standards.
* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating CPQ config templates, pricing rule patterns, contract migration scripts, Agentforce prompt and action libraries and billing validation tools.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Salesforce CPQ (SBQQ) — Hands\-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Salesforce CPQ end\-to\-end — products, price books, product rules, pricing rules, discount schedules, bundle configuration, guided selling, approval workflows, quote templates and amendment/renewal logic.
* Salesforce Billing Configuration: Hands\-on experience configuring Salesforce Billing — billing schedules, invoice generation, usage\-based billing, payment terms, tax engine integration and dunning workflows.
* CPQ \& Billing Data Migration Execution: Demonstrated experience loading high\-volume CPQ and Billing objects — Products, PricebookEntries, Contracts, Subscriptions, Assets, Orders — using Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API and ETL pipelines.
* Agentforce Configuration: Working knowledge of Agentforce agent topics, instructions, standard actions and custom Apex actions — sufficient to implement revenue agent blueprints defined by the Solution Architect.
* Apex \& Platform Development: Solid Apex development skills — Batch Apex for CPQ/Billing data migration, Schedulable classes, SBQQ plugin overrides, Apex trigger frameworks, REST callout adapters for ERP integration and Apex test classes.
* Lightning Web Components \& Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, CPQ validation UIs and Salesforce Flow orchestrations as internal factory tooling.
* ERP Integration Development: Experience developing REST/SOAP callout handlers and Platform Event subscribers for Salesforce Billing\-to\-ERP (SAP, Oracle or NetSuite) integration.
* ETL Tools \& Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory) for extracting and transforming legacy CPQ, contract and billing data.
* Data Architecture — CPQ Objects: Understanding of Salesforce CPQ data model — Quote, Quote Line, Product, Price Book, Contract, Subscription, Asset, Order and Billing object relationships.
* CI/CD \& Source Control: Comfortable in Salesforce DX and Git\-based workflows — committing Apex code and CPQ metadata, following branching conventions and using Gearset/Copado.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Experience migrating from Apttus/Conga CPQ, Zuora, Oracle CPQ or Salesforce Classic CPQ (Big Machines) to Salesforce Revenue Cloud
* Knowledge of Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) — dynamic revenue contracts and flexible pricing model configuration
* of Salesforce Subscription Management for direct\-to\-consumer billing model configuration
* Experience with multi\-currency CPQ configuration and multi\-entity billing setups for global enterprise clients
* Knowledge of payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Zuora) at the implementation level


**Experience Requirements**
* 5–8 years of Salesforce platform delivery experience with a focus on CPQ, billing and revenue operations
* 3\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce CPQ configuration experience across at least 2 CPQ implementations or migrations
* Demonstrated experience executing CPQ and contract data migrations — loading Products, Contracts, Subscriptions and Assets with relationship integrity at scale
* Hands\-on Apex development experience — particularly Batch Apex for data migration, SBQQ plugin overrides and REST callout adapters
* Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on CPQ configuration and data migration tasks


 SALESFORCE \& PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

* Required: Salesforce CPQ Specialist
* Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I
* Required: Salesforce Administrator
* Preferred: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Consultant
* Preferred: Salesforce Billing Specialist
* Preferred: Agentforce Specialist
* Preferred: Salesforce Certified Data ArchitectFamiliarity with Salesforce Industries (Vlocity/OmniStudio) — DataRaptors and Integration Procedures for telco/media CPQ automation
* Understanding

6497fd70.title: Enterprise Architect
6497fd70.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
   

  

 You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
   

  

 Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology\-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
   

  

 As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
   

  

* Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
* Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
* Assist organizations in embracing cloud\-native, API\-first, and event\-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
* Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.


 This is an opportunity to influence enterprise\-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
   

  

* Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI\-powered innovation.
* Translate business priorities into actionable, multi\-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
* See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
* Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.


 Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
   

  

* Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
* Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real\-time decisioning, and personalization.
* Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and microservices\-based solutions.
* Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long\-term scalability.
* Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.


 Drive Alignment and Transformation
   

  

* Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
* Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision\-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
* Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
* Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.


 Influence and Encourage
   

  

* Communicate architecture vision, trade\-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
* Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
* Advocate for data\-driven and AI\-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
* Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.


 Contribute to Adobe's Growth
   

  

* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
* Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
* Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.


 What You Need to Succeed
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
* Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API\-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
* Experience crafting and delivering cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience crafting AI\-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
* Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
* Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision\-making across organizations.
* Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.
* Experience working with digital marketing, customer experience, customer data, or personalization platforms.
* Knowledge of customer journey orchestration, decisioning, and real\-time activation strategies.
* Experience leading enterprise\-scale digital transformation initiatives.


 At Adobe, you'll do meaningful work alongside outstanding individuals who are passionate about innovation, creativity, and customer success. We are dedicated to helping our employees grow, thrive, and make an impact through continuous feedback, learning opportunities, and career development.
   

  

 If you're ready to build the future of digital experiences and assist organizations in transforming through data, AI, and cloud technologies, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
   

  

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

3623b991.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager \- ITOM Technical Architect**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using the ServiceNow platform, specifically focusing on IT Operations Management (ITOM). You will get an opportunity to work with a high\-quality team and build innovative solutions that address complex enterprise challenges.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Technical Architect with expertise in ServiceNow ITOM architecture and implementation to join the EY GDS ServiceNow team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in driving ITOM transformation and platform strategy for global clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management
* Define and implement scalable CMDB architecture, governance frameworks, and data models
* Drive end\-to\-end ITOM strategy, aligning ServiceNow capabilities with enterprise IT operations and business goals
* Architect and deliver event correlation, observability, and AIOps solutions using ServiceNow Event Management and integrations
* Design and implement Service Mapping solutions for business services and applications
* Lead Discovery implementation, including MID Server setup, credential management, and troubleshooting
* Drive integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and third\-party monitoring tools
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to development and implementation teams
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical and architectural specifications
* Ensure adherence to platform best practices, governance, and security standards
* Support performance tuning, scalability optimization, and platform upgrades
* Drive DevOps and Agile delivery practices across ITOM implementations
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, Cloud Management
* Deep understanding of CMDB data modeling, CSDM framework, and data governance
* Experience in AIOps, event correlation, and monitoring tool integrations (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds)
* Knowledge of infrastructure technologies: servers, networks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong JavaScript, Glide scripting, and ServiceNow platform development skills
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* Approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with significant exposure to ServiceNow ITOM
* Proven experience as a Technical Architect or Lead in ServiceNow ITOM implementations
* ServiceNow CSA certification (mandatory)
* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery / Service Mapping (mandatory)
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred)


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with CSDM adoption and enterprise CMDB strategy
* Exposure to multi\-cloud environments and cloud discovery
* Knowledge of latest ServiceNow releases and features


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with strong technical expertise, consulting mindset, and innovation\-driven approach
* Individuals passionate about digital transformation and IT operations modernization
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast\-paced global environment
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

9992a8ea.title: Program Manager
9992a8ea.description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
 We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.
   

  

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager is responsible for leading the program in all aspects, from program award until 6 months after Start of Production. He/she is the guarantor of customer satisfaction in conjunction with the achievement of program Quality, Cost and Delivery objectives, while ensuring profitability throughout the entire program lifecycle. The main missions of the role are to:
   

  

* Develop strong relationships and manage the ongoing negotiations with the customer as the official Faurecia representative
* Prepare and submit the RFQA to Management if relevant
* Liaise with the Program Controller, build the initial Business Plan, define the Program investment scheme, and release investments in compliance with controlling procedures; take economical responsibility for all deviations from initial requirements
* Launch and monitor the Program: track progress by updating Business Plan, Program Dashboard and Budget Reports, and by leading reviews of program steps and results
* Conduct Risk/Opportunity analysis, and develop and implement appropriate action plans
* Arbitrate any conflicts with the customer on financial and/or technical issues
* Staff, manage and co\-ordinate a cross\-functional program team, define team members' objectives and assignments
* Create a "Program Management culture" by ensuring processes defined in the Faurecia Program Management System (PMS) are applied at all steps, and by developing synergies between all actors involved in the program
* Organize communications throughout the program lifecycle
* Ensure smooth program transfer from Development Centre to Production Plant
* Organize key program information to ensure Program continuity and to contribute to knowledge management


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
* Bachelors degree minimum, Masters degree, ideally in engineering highly preferred
* Minimum 4 years of experience (in an industrial environment and/or with product experience a plus)
* Results orientation
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Conflict management skills : ability to prevent and solve conflicts
* Ability to work in a matrixed organization
* Good knowledge of Program standards, tools and methods
* Fluent in English and in the customer language
* Ability to establish, develop, lead and unite a team
* Strong financial knowledge (incl. building and following a Business Plan)
* Problem solving techniques
* Strategic and analytic capabilities
* Planning and organizing abilities


**What We Can Do For You**
* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA is an automotive technology group at the heart of smarter and more sustainable mobility. We bring together expertise in electronics, clean mobility, lighting, interiors, seating, and lifecycle solutions to drive change in the automotive industry.
   

  

 With a history stretching back more than a century, we are the 7th largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in 43 countries. You'll find our technology in around 1 out of 2 vehicles produced anywhere in the world.
   

  

 In June 2022, we became the 1st global automotive group to be certified with the SBTI Net\-Zero Standard. We have committed to reach CO2 Net Zero by no later than 2045\.
   

  

 As technological innovation and the need for sustainability transform the automotive industry, we are ideally positioned to deliver solutions that will enhance the lives of road\-users everywhere.

a0ec0513.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.

**Business \& Soft Skills**

* Excellent presentation, storytelling, and workshop facilitation skills.

* Ability to manage multiple strategic pursuits simultaneously.
* Exceptional collaboration across sales, delivery, consulting, finance, and leadership teams.

* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value narratives.

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert / AWS Solutions Architect Professional
* AI/ML certifications (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, etc.)
* Experience in AI governance, Responsible AI frameworks

* Exposure to GTM strategy, pricing models, or business development

### **BA/BS degree and 8\+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience**

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

fc93734c.title: Solutions Architect
fc93734c.description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Dostack Dostack helps enterprises own their AI. We build AI\-powered workbenches tailored to how enterprise teams actually operate \- their capabilities, constraints and culture. AI handles research, analysis, drafting and checking, while people retain judgment, accountability and control. The opportunity We are looking for a hands\-on Solutions Architect to lead that implementation alongside the founders and engineering team. You will sit between the customer's platform, security and business teams and Dostack's product and engineering team. You will take the implementation from technical discovery through deployment, integration, workflow validation and operational handover. THIS IS A HANDS\-ON IMPLEMENTATION ROLE ; You should be comfortable running a customer workshop in the morning, configuring Kubernetes in the afternoon and debugging an identity or API integration issue the next day. You will also help turn what we learn from this first deployment into a repeatable implementation model for future enterprise customers. What you will do : Earn customer trust, make the implementation work and build a deployment model that can be operated and repeated
   

  

* Lead technical discovery with customer platform, security, identity, networking and application teams.
* Convert customer requirements and constraints into an implementation architecture, dependency plan and acceptance criteria.
* Deploy and validate the Dostack runtime in a customer\-managed Kubernetes environment.
* Integrate customer\-provided PostgreSQL, object storage, OIDC, secret management, ingress, DNS, certificates and observability services.
* Connect Dostack to approved enterprise systems such as Salesforce and internal APIs through governed connectors.
* Configure and troubleshoot API keys, OAuth 2\.0 flows, network routes, TLS and organisation\-scoped credentials.
* Connect and validate the customer's enterprise LLM endpoint, including structured outputs, tool use and application\-level quality checks.
* Work with customer domain experts to translate real business processes into AI\-enabled workflows.
* Test workflows end to end using approved data and produce clear technical acceptance evidence.
* Diagnose issues across Kubernetes, application services, identity, APIs, model endpoints and workflow execution.
* Create installation, upgrade, rollback, troubleshooting and operational\-handover documentation.
* Train customer administrators and technical champions, and bring implementation feedback into the Dostack roadmap. What we are looking for
* Approximately 6\+ years in solutions architecture, implementation engineering, platform engineering or a comparable customer\-facing technical role.
* Experience owning at least one substantial enterprise software deployment from discovery through production or pilot acceptance.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker and Helm.
* Ability to troubleshoot Linux, containers, networking, ingress, DNS, TLS, storage and workload configuration.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications through REST APIs and OpenAPI specifications.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, API\-key authentication, secrets management and enterprise identity.
* Practical coding or scripting ability, preferably in Python, plus familiarity with PostgreSQL and object storage.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform, while understanding that customer environments may be private, hybrid or restricted.
* Applied generative\-AI experience with model APIs, prompts, structured outputs, evaluations or tool\-calling patterns.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the judgment to be transparent about risks and unknowns in front of a customer. You will thrive here if you
* Prefer building and troubleshooting to producing architecture theatre.
* Can move comfortably between business workflows and infrastructure details.
* Remain calm and methodical when several customer dependencies are moving at once.
* Treat security, tenancy and customer data boundaries as design requirements.
* Enjoy working directly with founders and shaping an early product Why join Dostack
* Own a strategically important customers from the beginning.
* Work directly with the founders and influence product and company direction.
* Receive meaningful early\-stage responsibility and equity.

e9f4183d.title: Cloud Security Engineer (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI)
e9f4183d.description:
**About Workstreet** 




 At
 **Workstreet** 
 , we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting\-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast\-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800\-171, NIST 800\-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.
 



  





**Get to Know the Security Services Team** 




 We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end\-to\-end ownership, our team spans three core functions:
 **Cloud Security Engineering** 
 , where we design hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, write Terraform baselines, and fix failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP;
 **Penetration Testing** 
 , where we run disciplined offensive assessments across networks, apps, cloud, and AI/LLM systems to catch vulnerabilities before adversaries do; and
 **Vulnerability Management** 
 , where we continuously prioritize, patch, and validate risk reduction across the client footprint. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption.
 



  





 What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers and assessors are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early\-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are seeking a
 **Cloud Security Engineer with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** 
 , including compute, networking, storage, and IAM experience, to help clients design, implement, and maintain security controls that meet compliance and security requirements. This role is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in cloud security engineering, compliance frameworks, and cloud\-based security best practices. You’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to strengthen their cloud security posture and automate security operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure environments.
 



  





***This is an OCI\-first role. Candidates must have strong, real\-world experience designing, securing, and operating Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Experience with OCI is a strict, non\-negotiable requirement. Applicants without substantial OCI experience will not be considered.***




  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Deploy and maintain robust cloud security controls** 
 across AWS, GCP, Azure, and OCI to eliminate misconfigurations and preserve strict regulatory compliance alignment.
* **Execute deep\-dive architectural risk assessments** 
 to surface cloud system vulnerabilities, evaluate asset exposures, and engineer targeted technical remediation blueprints.
* **Configure and manage enterprise security tool suites** 
 , including SIEM solutions, log analytics platforms, identity management layers, IDS/IPS tools, and vulnerability management engines.
* **Own the client relationship lifecycle** 
 as the primary trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio, establishing project milestones, managing communication pathways, and handling technical escalations with calm professionalism.
* **Programmatically enforce security controls** 
 by engineering automated, repeatable IaC deployment playbooks and security testing infrastructure.
* **Embed continuous security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines** 
 and containerized environments to intercept system vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle.
* **Investigate and contain cloud\-related security incidents** 
 , rapidly executing forensic logic and remediation steps to restore system integrity and minimize blast radii.
* **Support continuous audit readiness** 
 within GRC platforms like Vanta by systematically gathering, testing, and validating cloud configuration evidence.



  





**Who You Are** 



* **Proven multi\-cloud security engineer** 
 \- Command direct operational ownership of securing distributed cloud infrastructure, with hands\-on validation across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
* **Cloud security architecture expert** 
 \- Mastered advanced identity and access management (IAM) strategies, cloud network zoning, payload encryption standards, and systemic risk mitigation workflows.
* **Advanced security automation developer** 
 \- Highly proficient in utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) architectures, specifically building and deploying automated guardrails through Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Python, and Bash.
* **GRC infrastructure strategist** 
 \- Aligned technical, cloud\-native configurations directly against global regulatory compliance and audit frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA.
* **Surgical technical problem\-solver** 
 \- Apply rigorous analytical diagnostics to isolate cloud infrastructure vulnerabilities, resolve failing controls, and execute zero\-disruption remediation.
* **High\-impact client consultant** 
 \- Confidently orchestrate multiple client portfolios concurrently, partnering directly with US\-based technology founders, DevOps leads, and executive teams to scale cloud security maturity.
* **Elite technical communicator** 
 \- Deliver flawless written and verbal English communication that effortlessly translates dense cloud vulnerabilities and risk vectors into actionable business value.



  





**What will help you succeed** 



* **Deep data and monitoring tooling execution** 
 \- Advanced manipulation of enterprise logging platforms, vulnerability management engines, threat hunting feeds, and network traffic analysers.
* **Validated cloud security credentials** 
 \- Hold active technical certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or CISA.
* **Container and DevSecOps engineering** 
 \- Practical success auditing and isolating security boundaries within microservice architectures, Docker instances, and Kubernetes clusters.
* **Zero Trust deployment models** 
 \- Direct execution of identity\-centric security policies, network micro\-segmentation, and context\-aware access structures.
* **Commercial tenure in fast\-growth environments** 
 \- Documented history of scaling infrastructure configurations within hyper\-growth tech startups or elite managed security service providers (MSSPs).



  





**Important Note for Applicants** 




**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) expertise** 
 is a
 **mandatory** 
 requirement for this position. This is not a general cloud security role. Candidates
 **must** 
 have substantial, hands\-on experience securing and operating Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in production environments. Experience limited to AWS, Azure, or GCP without significant OCI experience will not meet the requirements for this role.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* **Career Development** 
 : Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
* **Role\-Related Training:** 
 Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
* **Competitive Compensation:** 
 A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit\-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
* **Growth Opportunity** 
 : Early\-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
* **Remote\-First Culture** 
 : Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.



  





**What You'll Need to Thrive** 



* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
* A reliable, high\-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
* Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET) to effectively support hiring managers, candidates, and cross\-functional teams. Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time\-sensitive hiring needs.
* Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.



  





**Hiring and Selection Process** 



* Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non\-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
* Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
* Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross\-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
* Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.



  





**Workstreet Is An Equal Opportunity Employer** 




  





 As an equal opportunity employer,
 **Workstreet** 
 is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at
 **Workstreet** 
 will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

f57b0840.title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
f57b0840.description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.


**C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.**


C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

7d260586.description:
**Description**
 Scope:
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager, RME SC Mile Partner, INOps leads all strategic requirements across Amazon India's Sort Center network, encompassing 20 SCs across 12 cities and delivering across the length and breadth of the country. The role oversees nine critical verticals: Safety, Cost, New Technology Initiatives, Reliability Engineering, Base Building Management, Asset Performance Management (APM), Sustainability, Skill Development and Business Analytics across a diverse portfolio of building formats including small, medium, large and Extra Large SC. The role drives transformative initiatives including SC Championships, a technician and Blue Badge skill enhancement and assessment program. The role runs MBRs with Mile Ops Directors and all stakeholder function leaders, maintains strategic connects with HR Leaders and Ops on Voice of Associates to foster a better work environment, manages OP1/OP2 workflows, Blue Badge headcount planning, and Free Cash Flow (FCF) initiatives.
   

  

**Complexity**
 This role operates at the intersection of high growth, rapid transformation, and start\-up\-like ambiguity. India RME is accelerating from reactive to prescriptive maintenance while preparing for technology disruption through scalability of sorters and reliability centric maintenance programs at Indian sites in 2027 and beyond. These factors create a uniquely complex operating environment that demands strategic foresight, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to build while simultaneously delivering
   

  

**Impact**
 The role’s outcomes directly shape INRME SC’s cost, reliability, and talent trajectory:
   

  

* Embed a zero\-tolerance safety culture across all SCs.
* Drive OP budget cycle while understanding site\-level requirements
* Drive \>7% YoY cost efficiency via reduction in reactive repairs and idle asset management
* Improve asset reliability, targeting 99\.9% uptime and 97% sustainability compliance.
* Drive WBR for the SC business unit, manages Transfer of Asset (TOA) processes.
* Drive SC Championship for RME team.


 Collectively, these initiatives will position IN RME as Amazon’s most reliable, cost\-efficient, and safety\-first maintenance organization.
   

  

**Reach**
 The position's influence extends across Amazon's entire global network through contribution to one VP\-level SPS transformation pillars \- Talent Excellence, engaging with global counterparts to shape the future of maintenance operations worldwide. The role partners closely with WWRME team on technician LOTO compliance and janitorial excellence. Internally, the role coordinates with Ops Directors, HR Leaders, WHS, Procurement, Finance, Solution Engineering, Real Estate, Environment teams, and site teams across all regions. Additionally, the role drives safety training programs as corrective and preventive actions post incidents, shaping network\-wide safety standards and practices.

 Financial: Govern RME SC OPEX and enable \>10% YoY savings through analytics, spare control, and preventive strategies.
   

  

 People: Develop technicians and close technical skill gaps through learning programs, capability building and reduced non\-technical workload.

13218d49.description:
**Description**  



  

  

**Company Overview:**


When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end\-to\-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM


Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end\-to\-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud \& Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

**Position Overview:**


As the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions for the Apple, you will own the end\-to\-end presales strategy and the service/solutions charter for Apple offerings across the organization's customer base. You will lead a team of solutions architects and presales consultants, drive win strategies for large and complex Apple Professional and Managed Services opportunities, and ensure that solutions committed during the sales cycle are translated into well\-governed, profitable service delivery.


This is a business\-leadership role that blends presales ownership, solution design governance, Apple partner/vendor management, and oversight of the practice's service and solutions portfolio.


You will act as the primary technical and commercial escalation point for Apple\-related opportunities, represent the practice with Apple and other OEM/ISV partners, and be accountable for the practice's growth, profitability, and delivery quality metrics.

**What you’ll do as the Presales Head / Manager – Service and Solutions, Apple:**

*The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

* Own and lead the presales function for the Apple Practice, including RFP/RFI response strategy, solutioning, and deal governance for Professional and Managed Services opportunities.
* Build and lead a team of Apple Solutions Architects and Presales consultants; set priorities, review solutions, and mentor the team on technical and consultative selling skills.
* Define win themes, differentiated value propositions, and competitive pricing strategies for Apple services deals in partnership with sales leadership.
* Present and defend technical and commercial solutions directly to enterprise customers, procurement teams, and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Drive proactive solution development – evaluation services, assessment services, professional services, and managed services offerings for Apple device lifecycle management.
* Own the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of all technical proposals, SoWs, effort estimation, and pricing models submitted to customers.
* Own the Apple Practice's solutions and service delivery framework, including standard offerings, delivery playbooks, and best\-practice documentation (SoPs, design documents, RACI, rollout approach, technical architectures).
* Ensure smooth transition of won deals from presales to delivery, including handover documentation, staffing plans, and governance cadence.
* Oversee lab setup and management (Apple Business Manager, Jamf, and other MDM platforms) used for solutioning, PoCs, and customer demonstrations.
* Govern service quality, SLAs, and customer satisfaction across managed services engagements; act as escalation owner for critical delivery issues.
* Lead services transition \& transformation projects, including migration of Apple services from one MDM platform to another.
* Drive continuous improvement of solution accelerators, automation, and tooling to improve delivery efficiency and margins.
* Serve as the primary point of contact with Apple's regional teams for joint go\-to\-market planning, enablement, and escalations.
* Maintain and grow relationships with Apple, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM/ISV partners to stay ahead of roadmap changes, licensing models, and co\-sell opportunities.
* Represent the practice in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry forums to strengthen the organization's positioning as a strategic Apple partner.

**What you will bring to the team:**

* Proven experience leading a presales, solutions, or services function within an Apple / device management practice.
* Deep understanding of Apple OS platforms (macOS, iOS, iPadOS) and associated hardware/configuration requirements.
* Hands\-on background with Apple Business Manager, JAMF, Scalefusion and other MDM tools (Microsoft Intune, Workspace ONE UEM, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of Apple auto\-enrollment, ABM, Enterprise security, zero\-touch provisioning, and APNS connectivity requirements.
* Experience designing and pricing Professional Services offerings, including effort estimation and commercial modeling.
* Experience managing partner relationships with Apple or other major OEM/ISV vendors.
* Track record of building and leading high\-performing presales or solutions teams.
* 7–10 years of overall experience, with significant time spent leading Apple\-focused presales, solutions, or services functions.
* Strong business acumen with experience owning revenue, margin, and growth targets for a practice or business unit.
* Proven leadership skills with the ability to build, mentor, and scale technical teams.
* Ability to develop executive\-level relationships with customers and partners, translating business priorities into technical and commercial solutions.
* Passionate about delivering exceptional customer experience across the presales\-to\-delivery lifecycle.
* Ability to engage confidently with enterprise and CXO\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated professionalism in customer and partner interactions, including solution defense and escalation management.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues, obstacles, and opportunities and drive effective solutions.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, taking a methodical approach to structuring best\-fit solutions.
* Commitment to meeting and exceeding individual, team, and practice\-level KPIs.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

**Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.**  

  

While we’re committed to providing top\-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value, they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.


At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

ca739ded.description:
**Job Description – Solution Consultant**

**Job Title:** Solution Consultant  
**Department:** Client Solutions / Business Solutions  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 5\+ years  
**Location:** Vidyavihar, Mumbai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Solution Consultant** with strong experience in **Credit Risk, Financial Analysis, Business Intelligence or related analytical functions**.

The role involves working alongside the sales team during client engagements to understand business requirements, interpret financial and risk information, and demonstrate how the company's solutions can create measurable business value.

This is a **specialist/overlay role** supporting sales pursuits rather than independently owning client accounts or carrying an individual sales quota.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the sales team during key client meetings, presentations and business reviews.
* Analyse client requirements and develop **data\-driven business cases**.
* Interpret credit reports, financial statements, risk scores and other analytical outputs.
* Conduct client\-facing sessions to explain reports, findings and their business implications.
* Translate complex financial and analytical information into **clear commercial recommendations**.
* Quantify the potential business impact and cost/risk associated with inaction.
* Support cross\-selling and account\-expansion opportunities by developing a strong value proposition.
* Work closely with Sales/Territory Managers throughout the sales cycle.
* Prepare presentations, analysis and supporting documentation for client discussions.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop solutions aligned with client requirements.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of **credit risk and financial analysis**.
* Ability to read and interpret **balance sheets, financial ratios and risk scorecards**.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong client\-facing and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in simple business language.
* A **consultative and value\-based approach** to client conversations.

80429cd4.title: Program Manager, Account Management
80429cd4.description:
Walmart Marketplace is a rapidly growing e\-commerce platform that empowers businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Manager, Seller Enablement to join our dynamic team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for driving the success of our third\-party sellers by providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive on the Walmart Marketplace.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 The Walmart India Cross Border team provides an opportunity for Indian brands, manufacturers, MSMEs and other potential sellers sell their products across global Walmart online marketplaces helping them expand their business internationally as cross\-border sellers on Walmart Marketplace (Cross Border Trade), where they could reach a growing market of more than 120 million U.S. consumers each month.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As the Manager, Category Account Management, you will be at the forefront of shaping the seller experience charter on Walmart.com for India CBT (Cross Border Trade) team. You will lead a team focused on developing and executing strategies that empower sellers to optimize their product listings, manage their inventory, understand performance metrics, and leverage various Walmart services. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational excellence, strong analytical skills, and a passion for helping businesses grow.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive seller enablement strategies, programs, and initiatives to improve seller performance, retention, and satisfaction on the Walmart Marketplace.
* Identify initiatives for enabling SOPs for driving efficiency in Category Management
* Strong stakeholder engagement
* Develop sustainable long term solves to enable category growth
* Identify key seller pain points and opportunities, then design scalable solutions and resources to address them.
* Drive the adoption of new Walmart Marketplace features, tools, and services among sellers.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to advocate for seller needs and contribute to the roadmap of seller\-facing tools and features.
* Oversee the creation and maintenance of high\-quality, actionable seller\-facing content, including guides, tutorials, webinars, FAQs, and best practices.
* Monitor and analyze key seller performance metrics, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
* Develop and present data\-driven insights to leadership to inform strategic decisions and resource allocation.
* Establish benchmarks and track the impact of enablement initiatives on seller success.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams including Product Management, Engineering, Business Development, Account Management, Marketing, and Customer Service to ensure a cohesive and supportive seller experience.
* Represent the voice of the seller in internal discussions and product development cycles.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, competitor activities, and best practices in seller enablement within the e\-commerce landscape to identify new opportunities to differentiate Walmart Marketplace's seller offerings.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 6\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplace operations, seller support, or a related field.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful programs that drive business growth.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively.

 At Walmart, we believe in providing opportunities for our associates to grow and succeed. 0da23498.title: Program Manager – Healthcare Technology
0da23498.description:
**Company Overview** 
**:** 




  





 Blue Pearl HealthTech (BPHT) is a Pune\-based healthcare technology company and the maker of eLABAssist, a cloud SaaS platform serving over 2,000 pathology and radiology laboratories across India and internationally. We build end\-to\-end laboratory information and management systems — from patient registration and sample tracking through to reporting, billing, quality assurance, and compliance — for labs ranging from single\-site diagnostics centres to large multi\-location corporate chains.
 



  





**Role Overview :** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Program Manager** 
 to lead end\-to\-end delivery of our next\-generation healthcare platform. The role will coordinate product, engineering, QA, infrastructure, implementation, and compliance, ensuring delivery timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder alignment are effectively managed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**Program planning and governance** 



* Own and maintain the master program plan across all workstreams — product, engineering, QA, infrastructure, implementation, and compliance — with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and risk registers.
* Define and run the cross\-workstream delivery cadence: weekly engineering and product syncs, fortnightly risk reviews, and monthly executive and stakeholder status reports.
* Maintain a live dependency map across parallel workstreams and proactively identify and resolve blockers before they affect the critical path.
* Produce board\-ready and investor\-level program status updates — translating technical and delivery detail into business\-level progress and decision points.



  





**Delivery and execution** 



* Drive delivery accountability across engineering squads and functional leads — without line management authority — through clear plans, transparent tracking, and structured escalation.
* Manage scope, schedule, and quality trade\-offs with product and engineering leadership, ensuring that changes are assessed for impact across the full program before being accepted.
* Own the risk register: identify, assess, and track program\-level risks across technical, resource, regulatory, and commercial dimensions, with mitigation plans for each.
* Coordinate QA and release management for major milestones — ensuring readiness gates are defined, tracked, and met before customer\-facing releases.



  





**Stakeholder management** 



* Serve as the primary coordination point between the co\-founders, engineering leads, product management, the business analyst team, and external implementation and sales partners.
* Manage relationships with enterprise customer accounts during platform onboarding and migration — coordinating implementation timelines, go\-live plans, and escalation resolution.
* Coordinate with international sales and implementation partners as the platform expands into new geographies, managing SOW governance, delivery timelines, and partner accountability.



  





**International expansion coordination** 



* Coordinate multi\-region deployment and compliance requirements across target markets including India, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the United States — working with legal, data, and engineering to track regulatory calendars.
* Manage localisation and market\-specific customisation workstreams — ensuring locale, language, currency, and regulatory requirements are captured, prioritised, and delivered on schedule.
* Onboard and manage international implementation partners: structured partner onboarding, SOW governance, delivery accountability, and escalation management.



  





**Process and documentation** 



* Establish and maintain delivery processes, templates, and documentation standards for the program — including decision logs, RAID logs, sprint planning artefacts, and release notes.
* Drive continuous improvement of delivery practices across the engineering and product teams, identifying bottlenecks and introducing lightweight process improvements without adding bureaucracy.



  
 



**Whar we are Looking for** 

 :
 




  




* 8\+ years of program or project management experience, with at least 3 years managing large, multi\-workstream technology programs — platform rebuilds, SaaS product development, or enterprise ERP/LIMS implementations — not just feature\-level delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing programs that span multiple functional teams (engineering, product, QA, infrastructure, customer success) with accountability for the overall plan rather than one workstream.
* Direct experience coordinating software rollouts across international geographies — managing localisation requirements, regulatory compliance calendars, and partner delivery accountability across at least two countries or regions.
* Strong stakeholder management: comfortable engaging with co\-founders and senior leadership, enterprise customers, and external partners in the same week, with communication calibrated to each audience.
* Excellent written communication: capable of producing a detailed dependency map for an engineering lead and a clean, concise board update for investors from the same underlying program data.
* Solid command of program management tools and practices: Gantt/milestone planning, RAID logs, dependency tracking, risk management, and release governance — applied pragmatically, not ceremonially.



  





**Preferred experience** 

 :
 




  




* Prior experience in healthcare IT, diagnostics, laboratory information systems, hospital information systems, or adjacent regulated software — with exposure to compliance frameworks such as NABL, NABH, ISO 15189, HIPAA, or CAP.
* Experience managing ISV\-to\-enterprise go\-to\-market programs — coordinating sales engineering, customer implementation, and post\-go\-live support as a unified delivery motion.
* Familiarity with cloud\-hosted SaaS product delivery on Azure or AWS — understanding infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and multi\-tenant architecture at a conceptual level sufficient to track dependencies and risks.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification is a plus, though demonstrated delivery track record is weighted more heavily.



  





**How you work** 

 :
 




  




* You are comfortable operating in ambiguity — building structure and clarity where none exists, without waiting for someone else to define the framework first.
* You default to written, asynchronous communication and treat clear documentation as a professional habit, not an afterthought.
* You escalate early and with options — bringing problems with proposed mitigations to leadership, not just status updates.
* You hold people accountable without friction — clear, consistent, and direct without being adversarial.
* You are genuinely curious about the domain and motivated by the complexity of building software that serves clinical and diagnostic workflows.

 Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions and value\-added services for freight and transit rail. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress, creating transportation solutions that move and improve the world. The freight portfolio features a comprehensive line of locomotives, software applications and a broad selection of mission\-critical controls systems, including Positive Train Control (PTC). The transit portfolio provides highly engineered systems and services to virtually every major rail transit system around the world, supplying an integrated series of components for buses and all train\-related market segments that deliver safety, efficiency and passenger comfort. Along with its industry\-leading portfolio of products and solutions for the rail and transit industries, Wabtec is a leader in mining, marine and industrial solutions. Wabtec has approximately 29,000 employees in facilities throughout the world.
   

  

* Visit the company’s new website at: http://www.WabtecCorp.com
