All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

888da5fe.title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
888da5fe.description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have
   

  

 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaSWorking command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-readyPresence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same roomHands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of oneExperience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access controlWriting that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually readEngineering background is a must
   

  

 Nice to have
   

  

 Contact centre or CX domain backgroundExposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyersMultilingual or Arabic deployment experienceTime at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery
   

  

 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, WFOOur customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office dayOccasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support
   

  

 WHY THIS SEAT
   

  

 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
   

  

 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.

As a Lead Solution Architect, you will be part of our SAP Platform \& Strategic Initiatives team. * Lead or advise on Supply Chain (Plan, Source, Make, Inventory Pillars) solutions roadmap and projects.

* Perform discovery projects by engaging with business units and SAP team members to find the best possible solutions for GMI.
* Lead, consult or participate in end\-to\-end implementations while also engaging as a functional solution architect in other parallel SAP projects
* Craft adaptable, comprehensive, and feasible solutions by creating necessary blueprint documents for functional requirements and technical specifications.
* Lead, review and/or participate in solution design, build, test and go live activities on SAP Supply Chain solutions implementations, rollouts, or upgrade projects.

* Review current standards and continuously revise to ensure best practices.
* Serve as the conduit through D\&T to enable businesses and technology.


**Minimum Qualifications**

**Role Description**
**Enterprise Architect \- Regional, eStore \& Core Platform Migrations**
**Role Summary**
 The Enterprise Architect will lead
 **end to end architecture for regional migrations to STEP platform and eStore related initiatives (Major systems in the platform include SAP, S4/Hana, Salesforce, IIB, Informatica, MDM and custom home grown applications) ,** 
 analyze
 **impact, integration, and transition** 
 .
   

  

 This role needs understanding of the current business process including but not limited to
 **customer, order to cash, finance, and reporting flows and** 
 cloud architecture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**CRM \& ERP Architecture**
* Own enterprise level architecture for Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA as part of regional and eStore migrations.
* Define target state interaction patterns, including but not limited to:
+ Customer, account, and contact mastering
+ Quote to cash / order to cash flows
+ Pricing, invoicing, and revenue recognition touchpoints

* Ensure data consistency and ownership boundaries between Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA, and downstream systems.


**Migration Architecture \& Strategy**
* Design and govern migration paths for CRM, ERP, and dependent applications, including phased cutovers and coexistence strategies.
* Lead impact analysis for Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA when migrating:
+ Country specific systems
+ eStore platforms and digital sales channels

* Ensure business continuity for sales operations, finance, and reporting during migration waves, including SAP backed analytics and dashboards.


**Integration \& Data Architecture**
* Define and govern integration patterns across:
+ Salesforce SAP S/4HANA
+ eStore Salesforce
+ SAP Enterprise Data Platforms / reporting (e.g., BOBJ, enterprise dashboards)

* Oversee data migration and reconciliation for:
+ Customers, products, pricing, orders, and financial data

* Ensure alignment with enterprise data models and source of truth principles.


**Enterprise Architecture Governance**
* Enforce EA standards, canonical models, and integration contracts for CRM and ERP domains.
* Review and approve Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA solution designs through Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
* Ensure migrated CRM/ERP assets are correctly registered, owned, and auditable in enterprise architecture repositories.


**Security, Compliance \& Controls**
* Ensure Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA migrations meet:
+ GDPR and EU regulatory requirements
+ Enterprise security, access control, and audit standards

* Define role based access, data classification, and segregation of duties across CRM and ERP platforms.


**Stakeholder Alignment**
* Partner with Sales, Finance, eCommerce, Product, and Regional IT leaders to align migration outcomes with business priorities.
* Act as the single architectural authority connecting business flows (including but not limited to) (lead order cash report) to technical execution.


**Core Experience**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years in Enterprise Architecture / Solution Architecture with large scale transformations.
* Proven experience leading Salesforce and SAP (ECC or S/4HANA) migration or transformation programs.
* Experience with multi country or regional ERP/CRM rollouts, preferably in Europe.


**Platform \& Domain Expertise**
* Salesforce: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, core CRM data models, and integration patterns.
* SAP S/4HANA: Finance, order to cash concepts, and integration with non SAP platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM\-ERP integration, master data management, and financial controls.


**Architecture \& Integration**
* API led and event driven integration patterns.
* Data migration, reconciliation, and cutover strategies.
* Cloud and hybrid architectures (Azure preferred).


**Nice to Have**
* eCommerce / eStore platform migrations integrated with Salesforce.
* Experience with SAP BOBJ or enterprise reporting platforms consuming SAP data.
* Prior involvement in audit heavy or compliance driven migrations.


**Success Measures**
* Zero disruption to sales, billing, and financial close during migration.
* Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA operating as cleanly integrated, governed enterprise platforms post migration.
* Reusable CRM/ERP migration patterns for future countries or acquisitions.

 enterprise application architecture,solution architecture,sap s4hana,salesforce cloud,

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.

**Requirements**

* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Personalization, Marketing Cloud Insights, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Data Cloud and Agent Force. Moderate experience with Sales, Service, Community, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

81625fc6.description:
Job Title: OCI Cloud Architect
 



 Location: Chennai /Hybrid
 



 Experience: 15 \+ Years
 



 Support time: UK Time Zone
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Job Summary We are seeking an experienced OCI Cloud Architect to manage and support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments across Development, UAT, and Production, including Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments. The role requires strong expertise in cloud security, application hosting, patching, upgrades, CI/CD pipelines, and the design of highly available and disaster\-resilient architectures.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the architecture and day\-to\-day operation of the OCI compartments across production, DR and non\-production tiers (DEV, TST, UAT, QA, SIT).
* Maintain secure, scalable, highly available designs across regions, including VCN design, DRG/FastConnect connectivity, load balancing and public/private access separation.
* Manage Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) application environments on OCI.
* Implement and manage OCI security including IAM, policies, compartments, and access controls.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.
* Host, Migration, operate, and support enterprise applications on OCI, including Oracle EBS.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automation for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for OCI provisioning and configuration.
* Design and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for OCI and EBS.
* Run vulnerability management and enforce security and governance standards — IAM policies, compartments, identity services, auditing and logging — within the customer's retained identity and security governance model.
* Design and maintain HA and DR, including Data Guard, remote peering and application failover; run DR tests and evidence RTO/RPO attainment.
* Perform DR testing, failover exercises, and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
* Apply shift\-left automation to reduce repeat incidents, and support FinOps review of compute, load balancer and storage consumption.
* Operate within the customer's change management (CAB), incident and problem management processes, respecting tenant ownership and break\-glass controls retained by the customer.
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.
* Excellent troubleshooting and stakeholder communication; comfortable working within a shift roster.
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and cost across OCI and EBS environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, database, and application issues across all environments.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity and cost; troubleshoot across infrastructure, database and platform layers.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; participate in service governance and reporting against SLA/XLA measures.
* Collaborate with application, database, DevOps, and security teams.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Experience: 15 \+ Years
* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Deep hands\-on OCI experience — networking, security, governance, compartment and tenancy design, multi\-region architecture.
* Proven experience running Oracle EBS environments at the infrastructure, OS and database layers, in a shared\-responsibility model alongside an application partner.
* Oracle Database 19c on Exadata (Exadata VM clusters / DB Systems), Data Guard, backup and recovery.
* Terraform and CI/CD pipeline delivery; automation\-first operating mindset.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Proven experience managing Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) hosted environments.
* Experience supporting Dev, UAT, and Production environments.
* Strong understanding of OCI networking, Security, and governance.
* Expertise in Oracle EBS administration, patching, cloning, Migration and upgrades.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Strong knowledge of High Availability and Disaster Recovery architectures.
* Experience with Oracle Databases (Autonomous, DB Systems, Exadata preferred).
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* OCI Architect Professional and/or Oracle EBS certifications preferred.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).
* Experience operating in an ITIL\-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi\-vendor governance.

8eabbd58.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Staff AI \& Cloud Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable AI platforms and intelligent solutions on AWS. This role requires deep expertise across AI/ML engineering, cloud architecture, MLOps, and Generative AI, along with strong experience in building enterprise\-grade, secure, and compliant SaaS platforms.
   

  

 You will be responsible for architecting end\-to\-end AI systems, enabling machine learning and deep learning engineering workflows, and driving innovation in GenAI and agentic AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, data architecture, and applied AI, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and governance.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Platform \& Solution Architecture**
* Design and build scalable, multi\-tenant AI platforms on AWS supporting diverse ML and GenAI use cases.
* Define reference architectures, reusable components, and best practices for AI/ML systems.
* Architect end\-to\-end AI pipelines spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Ensure platform readiness for SaaS environments, including tenant isolation, scalability, and cost optimization.


**Machine Learning \& Deep Learning Engineering**
* Lead development of machine learning and deep learning models for production\-grade applications.
* Establish standards for ML engineering, including data preprocessing, feature stores, training pipelines, and inference services.
* Optimize model performance, scalability, and latency for real\-time and batch inference systems.


**Generative AI \& Agentic AI Systems**
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and foundation models.
* Build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases and embeddings.
* Develop agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, and tool integration.
* Apply advanced techniques such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.


**AWS Cloud Architecture**
* Architect and implement solutions using:
* AWS SageMaker (training, pipelines, deployment)
* AWS Bedrock (GenAI services)
* Compute: Lambda, ECS, EKS
* Orchestration: Step Functions
* Storage/Data: S3, Redshift, DynamoDB, Glue
* Build highly available, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized cloud\-native systems.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.


**MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management**
* Establish and scale MLOps frameworks for continuous integration and deployment of ML models.
* Implement MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
* Build automated CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows.
* Enable model monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and explainability.


**Data Architecture \& Engineering**
* Design scalable data architectures to support AI/ML workloads (batch and streaming).
* Implement data pipelines, feature stores, and data governance frameworks.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, and accessibility across teams.


**Security, Compliance \& Governance**
* Architect AI systems with security\-first principles, including encryption, IAM, and network controls.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2 as applicable).
* Implement responsible AI practices, including bias detection, auditability, and explainability.
* Establish governance for data, models, and AI services.


**SaaS Platform Engineering**
* Design and implement AI\-powered SaaS platforms, supporting:
+ Multi\-tenancy and tenant isolation
+ API\-driven architectures
+ Usage metering and cost attribution

* Enable platform extensibility and integration with enterprise systems.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship across AI, ML, and cloud engineering teams.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making.
* Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI paradigms.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (PhD preferred) with a minimum of 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, and cloud architecture.
* Good expertise in Machine Learning Engineering and Deep Learning Engineering.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, core cloud services)
* MLflow and MLOps frameworks
* Good programming skills in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.).
* Proven experience designing and deploying scalable AI systems in production.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation).
* Good understanding of data architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience implementing secure and compliant cloud solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks and multi\-agent systems.
* Familiarity with LLM orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS).
* Knowledge of streaming and big data technologies (Kafka, Spark).
* AWS certifications:
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty
* Experience in enterprise SaaS platforms or regulated industries.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Expertise in scalable AI system design
* Good foundation in ML, DL, and GenAI
* Deep knowledge of MLOps and cloud\-native architectures
* Excellent problem\-solving and system design skills
* Good communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to balance innovation with enterprise constraints (security, compliance, cost)


**Impact of the Role**

cddd3b9e.title: Program Manager | Corporate Fitout - Project Management | Gurgaon
cddd3b9e.description:
**Company Description**
 Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a leading global diversified professional services company, specializing in commercial real estate services, engineering consultancy and investment management. With operations in 70 countries, our 22,000 enterprising professionals provide exceptional service and expert advice to clients. For nearly 30 years, our experienced leadership – with substantial inside ownership – has consistently delivered approximately 20% compound annual investment returns for shareholders. With annual revenues exceeding $4\.5 billion and $99 billion of assets under management, Colliers maximizes the potential of property, infrastructure and real assets to accelerate the success of our clients, investors and people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Description – Programme Manager**
 At Colliers, we are committed to empowering exceptional talent to deliver world\-class outcomes for our clients. As we continue to partner with some of the world’s most respected global organisations, we seek professionals who bring passion, precision, and leadership to every engagement. This role is a unique opportunity to work on a high\-visibility programme with a globally recognised financial services client, where your expertise will directly influence project success, governance quality, and stakeholder confidence. If you thrive in fast\-paced, high\-performance environments and are ready to shape impactful workplaces, we would love to connect with you.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Programme Manager will lead and govern a high\-performance delivery programme for a global financial services client known for stringent quality, compliance, and schedule expectations. The role requires meticulous controls, transparent reporting, and exceptional stakeholder management to ensure delivery excellence across design, base build integration, and interior fit\-out.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee all phases of project planning and delivery, ensuring alignment with global corporate standards and governance frameworks.
* Establish robust reporting mechanisms, risk registers, action logs, and change\-control systems.
* Coordinate with the client’s global and regional stakeholders for approvals, audits, documentation, and compliance.
* Drive integration between base build and fit\-out delivery to ensure seamless technical alignment.
* Lead project controls: cost management, scheduling, risk forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Manage design reviews, technical validations, quality benchmarks, and configuration standards.
* Monitor contractor performance, procurement timelines, commercial claims, and change orders.
* Ensure best\-in\-class HSE practices, documentation hygiene, and audit readiness.
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional PM teams with clarity, discipline, and accountability.


**Qualifications**
**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 20\+ years’ experience in the real estate sector.
* 10–15 years of Programme/ project management within corporate workplaces.
* Experience delivering for global clients with stringent governance standards.
* Degree in Architecture; PMP/ Prince2/ RICS preferred.

7a84eda4.title: Program Manager, Operations - Tamil Nadu
7a84eda4.description:
**About Mitti Labs**
 Mitti Labs is a climate\-tech startup dedicated to transforming the rice industry by supporting smallholder farmers in adopting sustainable practices. Our mission is to bring AI and satellite technology into traditional rice farming, reducing methane emissions while improving farmer livelihoods.
   

  

 Backed by NASA\-supported science and a strong ecosystem of partners, we work with global corporations to help them achieve their net\-zero goals through verified, high\-quality carbon credits. Our initiatives include building the world's most advanced dMRV for rice, launching a 40,000 farmers project in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh and reducing air pollution from stubble burning in Punjab. We have built partnerships with the likes of Syngenta Foundation, Dr Reddy's Foundation, The Nature Conservancy and Ebro Foods.
   

  

 Our customers \- including Fortune 500 companies and leading agri\-businesses \- trust Mitti Labs to deliver measurable impact across climate, food systems, and sustainability. We are a team of 40\+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers, and operators.
   

  

**Role Description**
 Mitti Labs is entering Tamil Nadu as we expand our climate\-smart agriculture programs across key rice\-growing regions. We are looking for a strong, strategic state lead/project lead who can build and manage Tamil Nadu operations from inception and ensure seamless execution of our carbon projects.
   

  

 Through our implementation partner, we will have a field force of around 100\. You will be responsible in ensuring partners meet their targets and execution happens seamlessly.
   

  

 Some of your objectives will include:
   

  

* Ensuring partners are meeting their tasks as per a pre\-defined roadmap
* Continually streamlining systems and processes to ensure execution
* Continually training, re\-training, and supporting the field agent force
* Holding field agents and partners accountable, and helping them problem solve and find solutions?


 We are seeking a driven task master, who has the ability to rally internal and external teams and the strong interpersonal and communication skills needed to meet these objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* External Partner Operations Management
* Maintain strong relationship with implementation partners teams, at managerial and execution level
* Strategise solutions with implementation partners basis problems
* Continually build and update SOPs and systems to ensure performance
* Collaborate with local stakeholders involved in the program, including agri universities, government bodies, NGOs, KVKs, Agriculture Departments etc
* Daily standups with Ops Execution team, QA/QC team, and implementation partner's teams (at managerial and operational levels)
* Ability to create network of logistics providers and local resources to support tasks
* Internal Communications
* Work with internal teams on carbon processes compliance, product, R\&D to ensure smooth implementation and communication of improvements
* Work on smooth execution of inputs distribution business in collaboration with inputs business head, and with support from inputs logistics team
* Daily/weekly analytics on performance on carbon processes, input distribution, and offer insights to Ops Execution, Product and leadership
* Offer support on Science Ops, R\&D ops, agronomic demos, etc
* Operational Execution and Leadership
* Take initiative as a leader of the program, manage state level teams, project coordinators and field agents to ensure on\-ground execution
* Building and maintaining granular task sheets and roadmaps, to ensure timeline and execution of projects are meeting requirements
* Drive farmer engagement programs through trainings, awareness campaigns and demonstration plots
* Oversee procurement, logistics and distribution of climate smart agri inputs to ensure availability and accessibility
* Ensure field agents are trained, and operating as per SOP, make quick corrections when deviations are observed
* Maintaining, updating and improving document repository of SOPs, Training Manuals, Processes
* Build marketing material in coordination with on\-ground teams to represent progress/success/wins basis data collected from fields
* Create input market material for field agents, how to pitch to farmer, how to sell product, with SOPs \+ Video walkthroughs


**Requirements**
 Your skills, mindset and demeanor should align with the following requirements:
   

  

* Passionate about climate, agriculture, sustainability, scientific innovation and impact
* Strong and independent task master, ability to design and execute on roadmaps
* Experience in Agri Project Management
* Strong communication skills and composure when dealing with large scale projects and large teams
* Process excellence mindset
* People management. High cultural sensitivity and ability to motivate rural teams.
* Ability to pre\-empt issues and offer solutions to fire\-fight
* Willingness to travel to fields on daily basis
* Ability to understand and engage with agrarian communities, understanding of farmers, FPOs, NGOs, Government Departments, etc..


**Experience:**
* Strong professional experience (7\+ years) \- ideally in agri\-project management, field extension management, input distribution/sales
* Category experience in Paddy farming is strongly preferred
* Proven experience in optimizing processes and building systems and strategies to support scale
* Strong educational background, preferably in Agribusiness management, Field Extension management, operations / supply chain strategy type roles
* Experience managing large field teams (100\-300 people) through partner organizations or direct teams
* Demonstrated capability in building high\-performance cultures, coaching mid\-level managers, and creating accountability systems
* Strong ability to create MIS, and monitor KPIs at scale
* Hands\-on experience using project management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, Excel, Looker Studio, etc.)
* Experience in multi\-district or multi\-state program rollouts
* Prior experience implementing QA/QC frameworks, audits, field validation checks, and adherence to SOP
* Experience in generating detailed stakeholder\-specific reports and documentation to synthesize findings and learnings to diverse stakeholders
* Experience ensuring compliance with carbon methodologies, government schemes, donor requirements, or agri certification programs
* Native fluency in Tamil is a must


**Benefits**
 Purpose driven work \- tackling the worlds most pressing challenges \- climate change, food security, water security, farmer livelihoods improvement.
   

  

 Culture / Team / Environment \- our team includes the best minds in science, product, business and operations, in an environment where collaboration and openness is highly valued, unbiased, objective decision making, direct relationship with founders, and encouragement of career growth in a rapidly scaling organization.
   

  

 Exposure to multiple stakeholders \- internal and external, ability to operate at the center of the organization.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please apply through this Google Form link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7JBre\_oKXlgFlgErc66XFqcZfTkc8Gjo\_QWLDEesTCPpCWw/viewform

06c2c151.title: Manager - Managed Services - Accounting and Finance
06c2c151.description:
**Overview**
 BTVK Advisory is a leading advisory firm whose specialized professionals guide clients through an ever\-changing business world, helping them win now and anticipate tomorrow. BTVK Advisory, and its affiliated entities, have operations in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. BTVK Advisory’s ultimate parent entity, Baker Tilly US, LLP, is an independent member of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion.
   

  

*Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*
*To be added to all ET through Experienced requisitions Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**
* Oversee end\-to\-end service delivery for clients, ensuring all accounting and reporting outputs are accurate, timely, and meet client expectations with minimal rework
* Manage and review production of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and adherence to deadlines across multiple clients
* Assist with managing client engagement staffing, billings/collections, and ensure client profitability targets are met
* Translate client requirements and expectations into clear, actionable instructions for the team, ensuring alignment between client needs and offshore execution
* Coach, train, and mentor staff on client service, and accounting matters
* Oversight and management of current client engagement team
* Provide leadership by promoting teamwork, developing training materials, mentoring, and managing workflows
* Demonstrate a solid understanding of each area of upstream oil and gas accounting, including Cost / Property Accounting, Revenue Distribution \& Recognition, and Financial Reporting, with expertise in at least two areas (AP processes and Joint interest billing, cost allocation, AFE management, JV partner reporting and division order management, cost accruals, LOS reporting and Trend analysis, production accounting driven allocation processes, revenue entry and recognition concepts, owner relations and DOI management, severance tax calculation and filing, specialty owner reporting and regulatory compliance, FP\&A, accrual and closes processes, treasury functions and controls, acquisition accounting, risk and hedge accounting, depletion and amortization, asset retirement obligation, and a basic understanding of the COPAS framework)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field required; CA, CPA, MPA, or MBA preferred
* Minimum 5 years of progressive accounting experience; professional services/consulting experience preferred
* Strong knowledge of GAAP and core accounting principles, including financial data classification, recording, and reporting
* Proven experience in upstream oil \& gas accounting, including cost/property accounting (AP, JIB, cost allocation, AFE, JV reporting, division orders, accruals, LOS and operational reporting)
* Solid understanding of revenue distribution and recognition, including production accounting, DOI management, owner relations, severance tax, and regulatory reporting (e.g., ONRR)
* Working knowledge of financial reporting for upstream assets (cash \& GAAP), including FP\&A, close processes, treasury, acquisition accounting, hedge/risk accounting, depletion \& amortization, and ARO
* Familiarity with COPAS framework and industry\-standard accounting practices; experience with tools like Wolfepak, Quorum, Enertia, or Bolo preferred
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel; ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies
* Strong client service orientation with ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment while maintaining confidentiality
* Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills with high attention to detail and ability to adapt and apply learnings effectively. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast\-paced, multi\-client environment.
